blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Code-switching is a natural linguistic phenomenon, yet its impact on high-level reasoning tasks remains largely unexplored in under-resourced languages like Romanian. Natural language processing tasks, such as satire detection, rely heavily on nuanced cultural and syntactic cues that large language models struggle to capture. In this paper, we investigate four methods (i.e., random replacement, phrase translation, dependency parsing, and large language models) for generating synthetic code-mixed Romanian sentences with English, German, French, and Italian. We start with an existing dataset for satire detection, compiled from Romanian news articles and annotated at the sentence level by humans, and augment it with over 600k samples, namely CS-SeLeRoSa. We provide an in-depth analysis of the dataset generation process. Then, we evaluate several multilingual large language models across zero-shot, chain-of-thought, and fine-tuning regimes on both the synthetic corpus and a human-adjudicated gold benchmark, namely CS-SeLeRoSa-Gold. While older open models suffer substantial degradation (dropping to 37%-55% macro-F1), newer models like Gemma 4 31B achieve 68.1% zero-shot, rivaling frontier models like GPT-5 mini (69.5%). Furthermore, fine-tuning significantly reduces formatting errors and improves the results, increasing Gemma 4 31B to 77.5% on CS-SeLeRoSa and 72.6% on the gold standard, outperforming frontier zero-shot baselines.
blocks.zh: 代码切换是一种自然语言现象,但其对高层次推理任务的影响在罗马尼亚等资源不足的语言中仍然基本上没有得到探讨. 自然语言处理任务,如satire检测,严重地依赖于细微的文化和合成提示,即大型语言模型难以捕捉. 在本文中,我们调查了四种方法(即:随机替换、短语翻译、依赖性解析和大语言模型),用英语、德语、法语和意大利语生成合成编码混合的罗马尼亚语句。 我们首先从现有的用于萨蒂尔探测的数据集开始,该数据集由罗马尼亚新闻文章汇编,并由人类在句子层面作注释,并增加了600多克样本,即CS-SeLeRoSa. 我们深入分析数据集生成过程。 然后,我们评估了几种多语言的大型语言模型, 跨越了零镜头,思维链, 并微调了合成体和人类判断的黄金基准, 即CS-SeLeRosa-Gold。 虽然较老的开放型号出现大幅退化(降至37%-55%的宏-F1),但Gemma 4 31B等较新的型号实现了68.1%的零发,与GPT-5等前沿型号相竞争(69.5%). 此外,微调大大地减少了格式错误并改进了结果,使Gemma 4 31B在CS-SeLeRoSa和72.6%的金本位上增长到77.5%,超过了前沿零射入基线。

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en:
Code-switching or code-mixing is a common phenomenon in multilingual communities in which speakers alternate between two or more languages within the same sentence Guzmán et al. (2017) .
While early natural language processing (NLP) and linguistic studies primarily mapped constraints on widely spoken pairs, the structural behavior of code-switching shifts significantly when applied to morphologically rich languages Myers-Scotton (1993) .
blocks.zh:
代码切换或代码混合是多语种社区中的一种常见现象,在同一句Guzmán等人(2017年)中,演讲者在两种或两种以上语言之间交替出现.
虽然早期的自然语言处理(NLP)和语言学研究主要勾画了对广语对子的制约,但当应用到形态丰富的语言Myers-Scotton(1993年)时,代码切换的结构行为发生了显著的变化.

blocks.en: Code-switching was previously explored in the context of satire, irony, and humor detection, but primarily in other combinations, such as Hindi-English Bansal et al. (2020) ; Aggarwal et al. (2020) ; Mazumder et al. (2025) or Spanish-English. For example, Bansal et al. (2020) investigated Hindi-English code-mixed tweets for detecting humor, sarcasm, and hate speech, arguing that code-mixing can be used to emphasize these phenomena. They also show that it can improve the model’s performance on downstream tasks. Belani and Flanigan (2023) proposed a dataset generated from transcribing day-by-day conversations for Spanish-English with various labels, including usage of code-mixing for jokes. Pant and Dadu (2020) proposed mapping the code-switched text to a higher-resource language through transliteration and showing improved performance for sarcasm and hate speech detection. However, this remains an underexplored area due to data scarcity. Consequently, many studies, including ours, rely on synthetic generation. This practice has positively spurred the community to develop diverse generation techniques, even though most evaluations continue to focus on downstream tasks using existing, naturally code-mixed text Aguilar et al. (2020) ; Sheth et al. (2025) .
blocks.zh: 以前在讽刺,讽刺,幽默检测的背景下探索了代码切换,但主要在其他组合中探索,如印地语-英语Bansal等人(2020年),Aggarwal等人(2020年),Mazumder等人(2025年)或西班牙语-英语. 例如,Bansal et al. (2020年)调查了印地语-英语代码混音的推文,用于检测幽默,讽刺,和仇恨言论,认为代码混音可以用来强调这些现象. 它们也表明它可以改善模型在下游任务上的性能. Belani和Flanigan(2023年)提出了西班牙语-英语日复一日的对白中转录生成的数据集,并附有各种标签,包括用于笑话的代码混音. Pant和Dadu(2020年)提议通过转写将密码切换的文本映射到高资源语言,并显示改进的性能用于讽刺和仇恨言论的检测. 然而,由于数据匮乏,这个领域仍然没有得到充分利用。 因此,包括我们的研究在内的许多研究都依赖合成一代。 这种做法积极推动了社区开发多样的生成技术,尽管大多数评价继续使用现有的、自然编码的文本Aguilar等人(2020年);Sheth等人(2025年)。

blocks.en: Mixing Romanian with other European languages is a naturally occurring phenomenon Wilhelm (2017) ; Buzilă (2025) . In the diaspora, many Romanians live, especially in countries such as Germany, France, Italy, Spain, and the UK, making it one of the largest diasporas OECD (2019) . Therefore, learning these languages is very common. Given these socio-linguistic factors and the scarcity of code-mixed satire data, we study four European languages, namely, English, German, French, and Italian, as target languages for code-switching with Romanian.
blocks.zh: 将罗马尼亚语与其他欧洲语言混为一谈是一种自然现象 Wilhelm (2017年); Buzilă (2025年). 在侨民中,许多罗马尼亚人生活着,特别是在德国,法国,意大利,西班牙,英国等国,使其成为经合组织(2019年)最大的侨民之一. 因此,学习这些语言是非常常见的. 鉴于这些社会语言因素和缺少编码混合的satire数据,我们研究了四种欧洲语言,即英语、德语、法语和意大利语,作为与罗马尼亚语进行编码交换的目标语言。

blocks.en: Automatic satire detection in news articles was introduced by Burfoot and Baldwin (2009) , which defines a satirical article as one that deliberately exposes real-world individuals, organisations or events to ridicule, incorporating devices such as irony and exaggeration. Unlike fake news, which shares similar linguistic features but has divergent intent, satire is often misinterpreted as misinformation Levi et al. (2019) . For the Romanian language, SaRoCo Rogoz et al. (2021) represents the first dataset for satire news detection, addressing the corpus-level classification. Recently, Smădu et al. (2025) proposed the SeLeRoSa dataset with higher sentence-level granularity. However, the intersection of satire detection with code-mixed text remains largely underexplored.
blocks.zh: Burfoot和Baldwin(2009年)在新闻文章中引入了自动讽刺探测, 将讽刺文章定义为故意让现实世界的个人、组织或事件受到嘲笑, 与假新闻有着相似的语言特征但意图不一不同不同不同,讽刺经常被误解为错误信息Levi等人(2019年). 对于罗马尼亚语,SaRoco Rogoz et al. (2021)代表了第一个用于讽刺新闻检测的数据集,涉及了实体级的分类. 近来, Smădu等人(2025年)提出了句子级颗粒度较高的SeLeRoSa数据集. 然而,萨蒂尔检测与密码混合文本的交叉点仍然在很大程度上未得到充分探讨.

blocks.en:
In this work, we create the first code-switched sentence-level Romanian satirical news dataset, namely CS-SeLeRoSa. It employs four different code-switching methods and four language pairs (English, German, French, and Italian). We provide an extensive analysis of the generated dataset using various metrics and benchmark several LLMs on the code-mixed dataset.
We summarize the main contributions of this work as follows: • We introduce CS-SeLeRoSa, the first synthetic sentence-level code-mixed Romanian satirical news dataset, exploring four generation methods and four language pairs. • We provide an in-depth linguistic and semantic analysis of the generated dataset across diverse code-mixing metrics. • We curate a human-adjudicated gold subset, CS-SeLeRoSa-Gold, verified by expert annotators, thoroughly analyzed. • We benchmark several LLMs on both datasets and evaluate their performance across zero-shot, chain-of-thought, and fine-tuning settings.
blocks.zh:
在这个作品中,我们创建了第一个代码开关的句子级罗马尼亚讽刺新闻数据集,即CS-SeLeRoSa. 它使用四种不同的代码交换方法和四种语言对(英语,德语,法语和意大利语). 我们对生成的数据集进行了广泛的分析,在编码混合数据集上使用各种度量衡和若干LLMs的基准.
我们总结这项工作的主要贡献如下: 我们介绍CS-SeLeRosa,这是第一个合成的句子级别编码混合的罗马尼亚讽刺新闻数据集,探索了四代方法和四语言对. ^ 我们对各种编码混合指标生成的数据集进行深入的语言和语义分析。 我们管理一个经人裁决的金子子集,即CS-SeleRosa-Gold,经专家注释员核实,进行彻底分析。 我们以两个数据集为基准,评估它们在零镜头、思维链和微调设置上的性能。

blocks.zh: 我们研究了一个人类判断的金子子集 CS-SeLeRosa-Gold ,经过专家的注释者核实,进行了彻底的分析.

blocks.en: We benchmark several LLMs on both datasets and evaluate their performance across zero-shot, chain-of-thought, and fine-tuning settings.

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en:
Code-Switching Tasks. Code-switching was evaluated in various natural language processing tasks. For instance, Krishnan et al. (2021) address slot filling and intent prediction. They take the set of text in the original language and, for each item, generate random translations for chunks, then perform label-level alignments.
A similar approach was applied by Tarunesh et al. (2021) for the Hindi language. In addition, they proposed a machine translation system which uses an encoder-decoder architecture trained using multiple losses: denoising autoencoding, backtranslation, and cross-entropy. Sterner and Teufel (2025b) investigated the alignment in choosing natural code-switched sentences over manipulated variants and showed that larger models tend to align better with the preferences of fluent bilingual speakers, who understand the social and syntactic nuances of code-switching. In a follow-up work, Sterner and Teufel (2025a) analyzed the syntactic difference between naturally occurring code-switched sentences and manipulated ones. They replaced the words with their parts-of-speech tags and, from the resulting structure, distinguished between sentences in minimal code-switching pairs. They proposed a graph neural network-based approach that achieves scores comparable to those of large language models across various language pairs.
blocks.zh:
代码切换 任务 在各种自然语言处理任务中评价了代码切换. 例如,Krishnan等人(2021年)的地址插槽和意图预测。 它们取用原语言的一组文本,并且针对每个项目生成块的随机翻译,然后进行标签级对齐.
Tarunesh等人(2021年)对印地语采用了类似的方法。 此外,他们还提出了一个机器翻译系统,该系统使用一个利用多种损失来训练的编码器-解码器架构:去诺化自动编码,回译,以及交叉输入. Sterner和Teufel(2025b)调查了在选择自然代码切换句子而不是被操纵的变体时的配对,并显示更大的模型往往更符合流利的双语演讲者的偏好,他们理解代码切换的社会和合成细微差别. 在后续作品中,斯特纳和特乌菲尔(2025a)分析了自然发生的代码切换句与被操纵的句子之间的协同差异. 他们用其部分的语音标记来替换词,并从由此产生的结构中区分最小的代码切换对的句子. 他们提出了一个基于图表神经网络的方法,实现与跨各种语言对的大型语言模型的分数相当的分数.

blocks.en: Previously, code-switching was evaluated alongside the detection of satire, irony, and sarcasm Bansal et al. (2020) , specifically for Hindi-English (also known as Hinglish). Shah and Maurya (2021) detected sarcasm from code-mixed social media posts, incongruity through sub-word embeddings in a bidirectional LSTM-based architecture Hochreiter and Schmidhuber (1997) . Ghanem et al. (2020) proposed the first multilingual and multicultural detection system for irony, in French, English, and Arabic. They evaluated feature-based models, such as random forests, and neural network models, such as a convolutional neural network, noting challenges in the dataset, such as informal language use and Arabic-specific challenges. Recently, more work has begun to address code-mixing in Arabic Hamed et al. (2025) .
blocks.zh: 此前,在检测讽刺,讽刺,讽刺的Bansal等人(2020年)的同时,还评估了代码切换(code-switching),具体针对印地语-英语(又称Hinglish). Shah和Maurya(2021)从密码混合的社交媒体帖子中检测到讽刺,通过子词嵌入基于双向的LSTM架构Hochreiter和Schmidhuber(1997). Ghanem等人(2020年)提出了第一个以法语、英语和阿拉伯语进行具有讽刺意味的多语种和多文化检测系统。 他们评价了基于特征的模型,如随机森林,以及神经网络模型,如进化神经网络,注意到数据集中的挑战,如非正式语言使用和阿拉伯语特有的挑战. 最近,在阿拉伯语Hamed et al.(2025年)中,处理编码混合问题的工作已经开始。

blocks.en:
Code-Switched Datasets. Pratapa et al. (2018) proposed to investigate the role of the equivalence constraint theory from linguistics to generate code-mixed text. Their approach suggested that using curriculum learning on generated samples can reduce the perplexity of language models. Salaam et al. (2022) created a real-world dataset and generated 30k synthetic sentences for code-mixing, for English to French, Spanish, and German. Multiple languages have been evaluated for code-mixing, and one of the most common combinations is Hindi-English Doğruöz et al. (2021) .
Large language models (LLMs) have been utilized in various code-mixed tasks Zhang et al. (2025) ; Lee et al. (2024) .
Recently, Xie et al. (2026) proposed SwitchLingua, the first large-scale multilingual and multi-ethnic code-switching dataset, consisting of 12 languages and over 80 hours of audio. However, it does not include Romanian. They also proposed LinguaMaster, a data synthesis method based on an agentic framework.
blocks.zh:
代码交换数据集. Pratapa et al. (2018)提议从语言学研究等效约束理论的作用,以生成编码混合文本. 他们的做法表明,利用在生成的样本上学习课程可以减少语言模型的复杂性。 Salama et al. (2022)创建了一个现实世界数据集,并生成了30k合成句用于代码混合,英语到法语,西班牙语和德语. 多语种被评价为密码混音,最常用的组合之一是印地语-英语Doğruöz et al. (2021).
大型语言模型被用于各种编码混合任务 张等 (2025); 李等 (2024).
最近,谢等人. (2026年)提议SwitchLingua,这是第一个大规模多语言和多民族代码交换数据集,由12种语言和超过80小时的音频组成. 然而,它不包括罗马尼亚语。 他们还提出了LinguaMaster,一种基于剂学框架的数据合成方法.

blocks.en:
Satire Detection. Automatic satire detection has been studied extensively in the literature, with approaches progressing from surface-level lexical features to structured reasoning, adversarial debiasing, and multi-modal architectures. Goldwasser and Zhang (2016) argued that satire detection should not be treated as a traditional text classification task but rather as a common-sense reasoning task. Focusing on political satire, they showed that satirical cues rely on finding patterns of absurdity rather than lexical word-level features.
Similarly, Yang et al. (2017) put satirical news classification in the context of fake news detection, noting both share similarities and can potentially be deceptive or even harmful. They showed that satirical cues are not uniformly distributed across articles and argued that paragraph-level features are more relevant than document-level features for psycholinguistic, stylistic, and structural signals. McHardy et al. (2019) proposed adversarial training as a method to identify and remove confounding variables from model representations. They showed that attention-based models were relying on superficial source-specific cues rather than genuine satirical features, and demonstrated that adversarial training can help the model focus on content-based signals. Li et al. (2020) investigated multi-modal inputs for satire detection, focusing on image and text modalities that could be combined in an unrelated fashion to make the news content absurd or ridiculous. Their results showed that unimodal models are outperformed by multimodal ones.
Later, Nandy et al. (2024) framed satire as involving conflicting scenarios, in which a scenario is juxtaposed with an ironical one that creates incongruity. They evaluated vision-language models on their ability to detect such satirical content. Abdalla et al. (2024) investigated large language models on the satire detection task, showing that chain-of-thought prompting and structured reasoning were key to achieving high performance.
blocks.zh:
萨蒂尔探测器 文献中广泛研究了自动萨蒂尔探测,方法从表层词典特征发展到结构化推理、对抗解析和多式联运结构。 Goldwasser和Zhang (2016年)认为,讽刺检测不应作为传统的文本分类任务,而应作为常识推理任务处理. 他们以政治讽刺为中心,表明讽刺的暗示依赖于寻找荒谬的规律,而不是词汇一级的特征。
同样,杨等人(2017年)将讽刺性新闻分类放在假新闻侦测的背景中,指出两者都有相似之处,有可能是欺骗甚至有害的. 他们指出,讽刺暗示在文章之间没有统一分布,并认为段落级特征比文件级特征更适合精神语言、语气和结构信号。 McHardy等人(2019年)提议进行对抗性训练,作为从模型表述中识别并消除困惑变量的方法. 他们表明,基于关注的模型依赖于表面的源特定提示而不是真正的讽刺性特征,并表明对抗性训练可以帮助模型侧重于基于内容的信号。 Li等人(2020年)调查了用于satire检测的多模式输入,侧重于图像和文本模式,这些模式可以不相关地合并,使新闻内容变得荒谬或荒谬. 其结果表明,单式模式的绩效超过了多式联运模式。
后来,Nandy等人(2024年)将讽刺描述为涉及冲突情景,其中一种情景与产生不一致的讽刺情景并列。 他们评价了视觉语言模型探测这种讽刺内容的能力。 Abdalla等人(2024年)对萨蒂尔探测任务的大型语言模型进行了调查,表明思维链的激发和结构化推理是实现高性能的关键.

blocks.en: 3 Method
blocks.zh: 3 方法

blocks.en: 3.1 Dataset
blocks.zh: 3.1 数据集

blocks.en: To generate the synthetic code-mixed dataset, we employ the SeLeRoSa dataset Smădu et al. (2025) , which contains approximately 13.8k manually annotated sentences from Romanian satirical and non-satirical news outlets. The dataset was already anonymized by replacing named entities with generic tags ( <PERSON> , <GPE> , <ORG> , and <LOC> ). We maintain this anonymization in the generated code-mixed dataset to prevent models from learning entity-specific satire cues and reduce unwanted biases. The official train/validation/test split is 9,800/2,000/2,073. We follow the same split in our experiments. To generate the code-switched dataset, we apply four techniques which are presented in § 3.3 . The resulting large-scale dataset is called CS-SeLeRoSa. In addition, we also provide a smaller human-annotated subset of this dataset, called CS-SeLeRoSa-Gold, meant for testing only. The full pipeline is illustrated in Figure 1 .
blocks.zh: 为了生成合成的编码混合数据集,我们采用了SeLeRoSa数据集Smădu等人(2025年),其中包含来自罗马尼亚讽刺和非讽刺新闻机构的大约13.8k手动附加说明的句子. 数据集已经匿名,用通用标记( " Personon " 、 " GPE " 、 " ORG " 和 " LOC " )取代了命名的实体。 在生成的编码混合数据集中,我们保持这种匿名,以防止模型学习实体特有的satire提示并减少不必要的偏差. 正式列车/验证/试运行分拆为9,800/2,000/2,073. 我们在实验中遵循同样的分化 为了生成代码交换数据集,我们采用了第3.3节中提出的四种技术。 由此产生的大型数据集被称为CS-SeLeRoSa. 此外,我们还提供了这个数据集中一个较小的人类附加说明的子集,名为CS-SeLeRoSa-Gold,仅用于测试. 图1说明了整个管道的情况。

blocks.en: Figure 1: End-to-end dataset generation for CS-SeLeRoSa and CS-SeLeRoSa-Gold . The data generation pipeline starts from the original Romanian monolingual SeLeRoSa corpus. Four code-switching (CS) generation strategies are applied to create the CS-SeLeRoSa dataset across K = 3 K=3 iterations, as presented in § 3.3 : random replacement, phrase translation, dependency tree-based, and LLM generation. From the resulting 600k+ code-switched sentences, we select 715 unique sentences which are then human-validated to produce CS-SeLeRoSa-Gold . The four methods are illustrated on a sentence showing generated variants (e.g., k = 1 k=1 or k = 2 k=2 ) for English.

blocks.en: 3.2 Translation
blocks.zh: 3.2 翻译

blocks.en:
To generate the synthetic data, we investigate several large language models (LLMs) for machine translation. Translation is a key component in generating the synthetic code-mixed dataset. The generation of code-switched sentences involves considering the sentence in the source language (i.e., the matrix language is Romanian), and applying a code-switching method that requires accessing a translation system to translate words or phrases to the target language. Then, the translated words or phrases are reintegrated into the original sentence, according to the code-switching method, to form a code-mixed sentence. Note that not all methods (e.g., end-to-end LLM generation) require a separate translation step.
For our code-mixing generation setup, we select Gemma 3 27B Kamath et al. (2025) to translate the text using the machine translation prompt in Appendix I . An evaluation of multiple candidate models for translation is provided in Appendix B .
blocks.zh:
为了生成合成数据,我们调查了若干大型语言模型(LLMs)用于机器翻译. 翻译是生成合成编码混合数据集的关键组件. 生成代码切换句涉及考虑源语言中的句子(即矩阵语言为罗马尼亚语),并应用一种代码切换方法,需要访问翻译系统将词或词组翻译到目标语言. 然后,翻译的单词或词组按照代码切换法重新整合到原句中,形成一个代码混合的句子. 注意并非所有方法(如端到端的LLM生成)都需要单独的翻译步骤.
我们选择Gemma 3 27B Kamath等人(2025年)使用附录一中的机器翻译提示翻译文本。 附录B载有对多种翻译候选模式的评价。

blocks.en: 3.3 Synthetic Code-Mix Generation
blocks.zh: 3.3 合成密码-混合生成

blocks.en: Introduced by Krishnan et al. (2021) , the random replacement approach performs chunk-level code-switching. For each input sentence, we split it into tokens at word boundaries and then randomly select a subset of words to replace with their translations. The number of words selected is given by a factor r r which in our experiments was set to 50%. As opposed to the original implementation, we use an LLM-based machine translation as described in § 3.2 , and ignore the anonymization tags during sampling. We acknowledge that the random-replacement strategy naturally yields degraded outputs. However, we applied the method exactly as proposed by Krishnan et al. (2021) without additional filtering to maintain consistency with prior work.
blocks.zh: 由Krishnan等人(2021年)介绍,随机替换方法进行块级代码交换。 对于每个输入句子,我们按词边界将其分割成符号,然后随机选择一个词的子集来替换他们的翻译. 所选择的字数是由一个系数r给出的,在我们的实验中这个系数被设定为50%. 与原实施不同的是,我们使用第3.2节中描述的基于LLM的机器翻译,在取样时忽略了匿名标记. 我们认识到,随机替换战略自然产生退化的产出。 然而,我们完全按照Krishnan等人(2021年)的提议应用了这种方法,但没有进行额外的过滤,以保持与先前工作的一致性。

blocks.en:
The phrase translation approach Salaam et al. (2022) is a three-stage method: phrase identification, phrase translation, and phrase reintegration. For phrase identification, as opposed to the original implementation, we employ multi-RAKE Rose et al. (2010) to identify keyphrases, using the vgrabovetsmulti_rake library from GitHub 1 1 1 https://github.com/vgrabovets/multi_rake , which supports the languages we investigate.
According to the documentation and Rose et al. (2010) , the algorithm is not limited to keywords (i.e., single words); it can also return multi-word keyphrases. Note that the algorithm does not make a difference between the specific kinds of keyphrases (e.g., noun-phrase, verb-phrase, etc). But in our case, this distinction is not relevant. Instead, it is relevant that the phrase must be self-contained, i.e., as a standalone, it should be complete and have a meaning.
RAKE does that by removing stop words and punctuation. Salaam et al. (2022) , who proposed the phrase-based code-switching approach, used the UCPhrase unsupervised model Gu et al. (2021) , which was trained on English data. However, this approach does not support other languages out of the box. The multi_rake package already supports Romanian and the other target languages, so we opted for this solution instead.
Next, in the phrase translation step, we use the LLM-based machine translation system from § 3.2 to translate the identified phrases. Finally, in the phrase reintegration step, we replace the original phrases with their translations. To increase diversity in code-mixed sentences, we randomly select which phrases to replace using uniform sampling. The motivation for this approach is that the chosen groups of words should make sense on their own to be translated coherently.
blocks.zh:
短语翻译方法Samaam等人(2022年)是一个分三个阶段的方法:短语识别,短语翻译,以及短语重返社会. 对于短语识别,与原执行不同,我们使用Multi-RAKE Rose等人(2010年)来识别密钥词,使用来自GitHub 11 1的vgrabovetsmulti_rake库 https://github.com/vgrabovets/multi_rake,支持我们调查的语言.
根据文献和Rose等人(2010年),算法不仅限于关键词(即单词);它也可以返回多词密钥词. 注意该算法并不区分特定种类的密钥句(如名词句,动词句等). 但对我们来说,这种区分并不相关。 相反,该短语必须是自成一体的,即作为一个独立的短语,它应该是完整的,具有意义.
RAKE这样做的方法是删除停止的单词和标点. Salam et al. (2022),他提出了基于短语的代码切换方法,使用了UCPhrase无监督的模型Gu et al. (2021),该模型接受了英语数据培训. 然而,这种方法并不支持框外的其他语言. multi_rake软件包已经支持了罗马尼亚语和其他目标语言,因此我们选择了这个解决方案.
接下来,在短语翻译步骤中,我们使用基于LLM的机器翻译系统从§3.2翻译识别的短语. 最后,在重返社会步骤中,我们用译文取代原来的短语。 为了增加代码混合句子的多样性,我们随机选择用统一抽样来取代哪个短语. 这样做的动机是,所选择的词组本身应该有道理,以便一致地翻译。

blocks.en:
Gregorius and Okadome (2022) proposed code-switching text generation using a machine translation system and a syntactic dependency parser. This approach does not require training models on parallel corpora; its components are plug-and-play and already available. The idea relies on finding a code-switching point by leveraging the properties of the dependency graph
and then using the machine translation system (e.g., from § 3.2 ) to translate the phrase spanned by the sub-tree to the other language.
This takes the phrase translation idea to the next level by considering sub-trees that are large enough to be self-contained, providing more context for the translator. However, it is therefore limited by the quality of the dependency parser and the machine translation system. For the implementation, we rely on the spaCy 2 2 2 https://spacy.io/ dependency parser for Romanian, ro_core_news_lg .
blocks.zh:
Gregorius和Okadome(2022年)提议使用机器翻译系统和合成依赖解析器进行代码切换文本生成. 这种方法不需要平行阵型的培训模式;其组件是插件和游戏,并且已经可用. 该想法依赖于借助依赖图的属性来找到代码切换点
,然后使用机器翻译系统(例如从第3.2节)来翻译子树横跨的短语到其他语言.
这把词组的翻译想法带到了下一个层次,通过考虑大小足够自足的子树,为翻译者提供更多的上下文. 然而,它因此受到依赖解析器和机器翻译系统质量的限制。 为了执行,我们依靠罗马尼亚语的Space 2 2 2 https://spacy.io/dependence parser,ro_core_news_lg。

blocks.en: Large language models (LLMs) have demonstrated impressive capabilities in various natural language processing tasks, including text generation, translation, and code-mixing Yang and Chai (2025) . We explore the use of LLMs to generate code-mixed sentences directly in the zero-shot setting. Therefore, we prompt the model, in our case, Gemma 3 27B with temperature set to 0.8, to generate a code-mixed version in the given languages, preserving the original meaning (see Appendix I for the prompts). Note that in this setting, the generation is performed end-to-end by the LLM, and therefore the translation does not follow § 3.2 .
blocks.zh: 大语言模型(LLMs)在各种自然语言处理任务中表现出令人印象深刻的能力,包括文本生成,翻译,以及代码混音杨和柴(2025). 我们探索使用LLMs在零镜头设定中直接生成代码混合句子. 因此,我们促使模型,就我们的情况来说,温度设定为0.8的Gemma 3 27B,以给定语言生成一个代码混合的版本,保留原意(提示符见附录一). 请注意,在此设定中,生成由LLM进行端对端,因此译名不遵循§3.2.

blocks.en: 3.4 Dataset Statistics
blocks.zh: 3.4 数据集统计

blocks.en: Table 1 summarizes the statistics of the generated code-mixed dataset CS-SeLeRoSa. We use 4 language pairs, i.e., Romanian (RO) to English (EN), German (DE), French (FR), and Italian (IT), and 4 code-mixing methods described in § 3.3 . For each language pair and method, we generate at most K = 3 K=3 code-mixed examples (with IDs from 1 to 3, 0 indicating the original sentence). We maintain the original dataset split into train, validation, and test sets, by the original source sentence.
blocks.zh: 表1汇总了生成的编码混合数据集CS-SeLeRoSa的统计数据. 我们使用4种语言对,即罗马尼亚语对英语(EN)、德语(DE)、法语(FR)和意大利语(IT),以及第3.3节所述的4种编码混合方法。 对于每种语言配对和方法,我们最多生成K = 3 K = 3 代码混合示例(其中ID从1到3,0表示原始句子). 我们按原源句将原数据集分为列车,验证和测试集.

blocks.en: The original Romanian dataset has 13,873 samples, which were processed preserving the original train/validation/test splits. For every sample, we apply 4 code-switch generation methods (random, phrase, dependency, and LLM) on 4 target languages (English, French, German, Italian), yielding at most 16 combinations per sample (i.e., 16 × 13,873 = 221,968 16\times 13,873=221,968 total). We repeat each combination K = 3 K=3 times, resulting in at most 665,904 code-switched samples. However, some generation attempts fail to produce all 3 variants. Additionally, the dependency-based method failed to produce sub-trees from 3 single-word sentences; therefore, 12 such cases are ignored (3 sentences across 4 languages), resulting in a maximum of 221,956 samples for k=1. The counts decrease further for k=2 (221,716) and k=3 (219,306) as sentences with fewer than 3 variants are excluded at higher k levels. For example, for some short samples, we could not extract three different sub-trees for the dependency method. Further analysis regarding code-mixing quality, lexical diversity, and semantic preservation across all methods is presented in Appendix C .
blocks.zh: 最初的罗马尼亚数据集有13,873个样本,经过处理后保留了原来的列车/验证/测试拆分. 对于每个样本,我们对4种目标语言(英语,法语,德语,意大利语)采用4种代码切换生成方法(随机,短语,依赖,和LLM),每个样本最多产生16种组合(即16×13,873=221,968 16\时13,873=221,968总). 我们重复K = 3 K = 3次,最多产生665,904个密码切换样本。 然而,一些世代的尝试未能产生所有3种变体. 此外,基于依赖的方法未能从3个单词句产生子树;因此,有12个此类案例被忽略(4种语言的3个句子),导致k=1的样本最多达到221,956个. K=2(221 716)和k=3(219 306)的计算进一步减少,因为较高K级的刑期中不包括少于3个变式的刑期。 例如,对于一些简短的样本,我们无法为依赖方法提取三个不同的亚树. 附录C进一步分析了各种方法的编码混合质量、词汇多样性和语义保存。

blocks.en: For the human-annotated gold set, CS-SeLeRoSa-Gold, we randomly sample 50 original sentences and extract their corresponding code-mixed variants across the four methods and four languages. After deduplication and removing failed translations, 715 samples remained for annotation. Following human adjudication, 391 high-quality samples were retained. Appendix F presents the annotation protocol, data selection, and statistics across annotation and the final gold set.
blocks.zh: 对于人类附加说明的金本位CS-SeLeRoSa-Gold,我们随机抽取了50句原始句子,并抽取了它们相应的编码混合变体,跨越了四种方法和四种语言. 在分解和删除失败的翻译后,仍有715个样本进行注释。 经人类判断,保留了391个优质样本. 附 录 F提供了注释协议、数据选择和统计,包括注释和最后的金本位。

blocks.zh: 4 实验设置

blocks.en: 4.1 Classification Task
blocks.zh: 4.1 分类任务

blocks.en: We address satire news detection as a binary classification task. Let D = { ( x i , y i ) } i = 1 N D=\{(x_{i},y_{i})\}_{i=1}^{N} be a dataset of size N N , where x i = ( x i 1 , x i 2 , … , x i n i ) x_{i}=(x_{i}^{1},x_{i}^{2},\dots,x_{i}^{n_{i}}) is a sentence of n i n_{i} tokens, and y i ∈ { 0 , 1 } y_{i}\in\{0,1\} represents the label of the sentence (0 for regular/factual, 1 for satire). In the monolingual setting, each word x i j x_{i}^{j} comes from the matrix language (e.g., Romanian). However, in the code-switching setting, x i j x_{i}^{j} originates from either the matrix language or the embedded target language. Importantly, the language assignment for each word must align with established code-switching linguistic theories. In our approach, we follow the Matrix Language Frame (MLF) model Myers-Scotton (1993) , where each sentence preserves the grammatical structure of the original Matrix Language (ML) frame, i.e., Romanian in our case. The translated segments function as Embedded Language (EL) islands inserted into this frame. Following the constraints of the MLF model, these EL structures must be internally well-formed and semantically self-contained, meaning that if these translated parts are isolated, they remain inherently understandable. However, the random code-switching generation method often does not follow this principle, resulting in syntactically or semantically unnatural samples.

blocks.en: In our LLM-based evaluation protocol, the language model is given a prompt specifying the task, language pair, target classes, and input sentence. In the zero-shot and chain-of-thought settings, the model is provided with output formatting instructions, while chain-of-thought additionally requests a reasoning trace. The fine-tuning prompt, however, is minimal, containing only the task description, input sentence, and target answer. All classification prompt templates, along with their English translations, are presented in Appendix I .
blocks.zh: 在我们基于LLM的评价协议中,语言模型被赋予一个快速指定任务,语言对等,目标类,和输入句. 在零镜头和思维链设置中,该模型得到了输出格式化的指令,而思维链则额外要求推理跟踪. 然而,微调的速率是最小的,只包含任务描述,输入句子,以及目标答案. 所有分类提示模板及其英文译本载于附录一。

blocks.en: The classes are discrete labels (i.e., “satire” or “factual” ) which are replaced in the prompt templates. To avoid position bias ( Zheng et al., 2023 ) , we shuffle the positions of those labels in the text randomly (i.e., “satire or factual” or “factual or satire” ). The models are tasked to produce XML-like structured responses, from which we extract the predicted labels. Reasoning traces are kept for further analysis, while the string labels are converted to numerical values, i.e., factual is mapped to 0 and satire is mapped to 1. Outputs that fail to parse are treated as classification errors (detailed in Appendix G.7 ).
blocks.zh: 分类是离散标签(即“satire”或“fact”),在即时模板中替换。 为了避免立场偏差(郑等人,2023年),我们在文本中随意地(即“保留或事实”或“事实或讽刺”)打乱这些标签的立场。 这些模型的任务是产生类似XML的结构化响应,我们从中提取预测的标签. 理性的痕迹被保存下来进行进一步分析,而字符串标签被转换成数值,即事实映射到0,而satire映射到1. 未分析的产出作为分类错误处理(详见附录G.7)。

blocks.en: 4.2 Models
blocks.zh: 4.2 模式

blocks.en: On the CS-SeLeRoSa test set, we evaluate several LLMs in the zero-shot (ZS) setting, with and without chain-of-thought (CoT) prompting Wei et al. (2022) , as well as fine-tuning (FT). We include open-weights and proprietary models in the evaluation. Specifically, for open-weights models, we evaluate Gemma 3 27B ( Kamath et al., 2025 ) , Gemma 4 26B A4B and Gemma 4 31B Abd et al. (2026) , Llama 3.1 8B Grattafiori et al. (2024) , and Romanian LLMs ( Masala et al., 2024 ) such as RoMistral 7B, RoLlama 3.1 8B, and RoGemma 2 9B. For the closed-source models, we employ OpenAI’s models, such as GPT-4.1 mini OpenAI et al. (2024) , GPT-5 mini Singh et al. (2026) , and GPT-6 Luna OpenAI (2026b) . On the CS-SeLeRoSa-Gold test set, additionally, we also evaluate GPT-5 Singh et al. (2026) , GPT-6 Astra, GPT-6 Sol OpenAI (2026b) , and GPT-6.1 Sol OpenAI (2026a) as frontier models. The fine-tuning regime is exclusively performed on open-weights models, while proprietary reasoning models are evaluated only in the zero-shot setting, as they natively generate internal reasoning traces before responding.
blocks.zh: 在CS-SeLeRosa测试集上,我们评价了零镜头(ZS)设定中数个LLMs,有和无思维链(COT)提示Wei等人(2022)以及微调(FT). 我们把开放加权和专有模式纳入评价。 具体来说,对于开放重量模型,我们评价Gemma 3 27B(Kamath等人,2025年),Gemma 4 26B A4B和Gemma 4 31B。 Abd等人(2026年),Llama 3.1 8B Grattafiori等人(2024年),以及罗马尼亚LLMs(Masala等人,2024年),如RoMistral 7B,RoLlama 3.1 8B,以及RoGemma 2 9B. 对于闭源模型,我们使用OpenAI的模型,例如GPT-4.1小型OpenAI等人(2024年),GPT-5微型辛格等人(2026年),以及GPT-6 Luna OpenAI (2026b). 在CS-SeLeRosa-Gold测试集上,我们还评价了GPT-5 Singh等人(2026年),GPT-6 Astra,GPT-6 Sol OpenAI(2026b),以及GPT-6.1 Sol OpenAI(2026a)作为前沿模型. 微调制度完全在开放量级模型上进行,而专有推理模型则只在零镜头设定中进行评价,因为它们在回应前在本土产生内部推理痕迹.

blocks.en: 4.3 Evaluation Metrics
blocks.zh: 4.3 评价计量

blocks.en: For the satirical code-switching classification, we focus our analysis on macro-averaged F1-score (F1). We also provide accuracy results in Appendix G.3 , which generally shows similar trends to F1-score. For open-weights models, we report the mean and standard deviation across N = 3 N=3 independent runs with different random seeds. For proprietary models, we report single-run results, except for zero-shot evaluation on CS-SeLeRoSa-Gold where we report the mean and standard deviation over N = 3 N=3 runs (proprietary CoT on Gold uses a single run). Statistical significance against the best-performing open-weights model (i.e., Gemma 4 31B) is indicated in the detailed appendix tables.
blocks.zh: 对于讽刺性的代码切换分类,我们集中分析宏观平均F1-分数(F1). 我们还在附录G.3中提供准确结果,一般显示与F1-分数相似的趋势。 对于开放量子模型,我们报告N = 3 N = 3 不同随机种子的独立运行的平均值和标准偏差. 对于专有模型,我们报告单运行结果,除了CS-SeLeRoSa-Gold的零镜头评价,我们报告N=3N=3运行(Gold上的专有CoT使用单运行)的平均和标准偏差. 详细的附录表格中列出了与业绩最好的开放加权模型(即Gemma 4 31B)相比的统计意义。

blocks.en: 5 Results
blocks.zh: 5 结果

blocks.en: Table 2: Macro-averaged F1-score (%) results on the three evaluation sets from monolingual SeLeRoSa, CS-SeLeRoSa, and CS-SeLeRoSa-Gold. Models are evaluated in zero-shot (ZS), chain-of-thought (CoT), and fine-tuning (FT) settings. The first set of models are open-source models evaluated in all settings, the second set are closed-source models evaluated only in ZS or CoT settings, and the third set represents frontier models evaluated only on the CS-SeLeRoSa-Gold test set. Bold indicates the best performance per setting and dataset, across all models.
blocks.zh: 表2:单一语言的SeLeRoSa、CS-SeLeRoSa和CS-SeLeRoSa-Gold三套评价的宏观平均F1-分数(%)。 模型在零镜头(ZS),思维链(COT)和微调(FT)设置中进行评估. 第一组模型是在所有设置中评价的开源模型,第二组是仅在ZS或CoT设置中评价的开源模型,第三组代表仅在CS-SeLeRoSa-Gold测试集上评价的前沿模型. 粗体表示所有模型中每个设置和数据集的最佳性能.

blocks.en: We present the overall results in Table 2 across the monolingual SeLeRoSa baseline, the synthetic CS-SeLeRoSa test split, and the human-adjudicated CS-SeLeRoSa-Gold benchmark. We organize our empirical findings around three core research questions: (RQ1) performance degradation under code-switching across model families, (RQ2) mitigating performance drops via Chain-of-Thought reasoning or fine-tuning, and (RQ3) failure modes across generation methods and target languages. Detailed per-setting breakdowns and full accuracy results are provided in Appendix G .
blocks.zh: 我们在表2中列出了单一语言的SeLeRosa基线、合成CS-SeLeRosa测试分数以及人判断的CS-SeLeRoSa-Gold基准的总体结果。 我们围绕三个核心研究问题组织我们的经验性发现:(RQ1)在跨模范家庭代码切换下性能退化,(RQ2)通过思维链推理或微调来缓解性能下降,(RQ3)跨生成方法和目标语言的故障模式. 附录G提供了按设定分列的详细细目和完全准确的结果。

blocks.en: RQ1: To what extent does code-switching degrade satire detection across open-weight and frontier models?
blocks.zh: RQ1: 密码切换在开放重量型和前沿型号上在多大程度上降解了萨蒂尔检测?

blocks.en: Multilingual models are capable of processing diverse languages; however, code-switching introduces severe pragmatic and syntactic challenges. As shown in Table 2 , under the zero-shot setting, performance degradation is influenced by model scale and generation. Older-generation and smaller models collapse: Gemma 3 27B drops by 12.9 macro-F1 points (49.9 to 37.0), while Romanian-adapted models such as RoLlama 3.1 8B and RoMistral 7B drop by 9.0 and 4.4 points, respectively. For Llama 3.1 8B and RoMistral 7B, we also observe very high run-to-run variance ( ± 15.2 \pm 15.2 and ± 14.4 \pm 14.4 ), which arises from parse and instruction-following failures under the zero-shot code-switching setting (see Table 27 from Appendix G.7 ). In contrast, modern open-weights models prove far more resilient. Gemma 4 31B and 26B drop by only 2.1 and 3.3 F1 points, respectively, achieving among the highest overall scores and matching proprietary models such as GPT-5 mini ( − 1.8 -1.8 drop) and GPT-6 Luna ( − 1.1 -1.1 drop).
blocks.zh: 多语种模式能够处理多种语言;然而,代码切换带来了严重的务实和协同挑战. 如表2所示,在零镜头设定下,性能退化受模型尺度和生成的影响. 老一代和较小的模型崩溃:Gemma 3 27B降12.9 macro-F1分(49.9至37.0),而RoLlama 3.1 8B和RoMistral 7B等罗马尼亚适应的模型分别降9.0和4.4分. 对于Llama 3.1 8B和RoMistral 7B,我们也观察到运行中的非常高的差额(±15.2\pm 15.2和±14.4\pm 14.4),这是在零镜头代码切换设置下进行解析和指令跟踪失败产生的(见附录G.7表27)。 相比之下,现代的开放量级模型被证明具有更大的弹性. Gemma 4 31B和26B分别只降2.1分和3.3 F1分,在总分最高的成绩和匹配的专有模式中,如GPT-5 迷你(−1.8-1.8降)和GPT-6 Luna(−1.1-1.1降).

blocks.en: Evaluating models on the human-adjudicated CS-SeLeRoSa-Gold benchmark reveals an interesting interaction: weaker models remain largely consistent from synthetic to Gold ( ± 2 \pm 2 points; e.g., Gemma 3 27B changes by − 0.9 -0.9 , Llama 3.1 8B by − 1.8 -1.8 , RoGemma 2 9B by + 1.8 +1.8 , and RoLlama by + 2.2 +2.2 ), whereas capable models drop noticeably (Gemma 4 26B by 5.5 points, Gemma 4 31B by 6.3 points, GPT-6 Luna by 8.9 points, and GPT-5 mini by 9.9 points). This indicates that these models partially overreact to certain patterns of the synthetic generation. When evaluating the frontier models on the gold set, models from the GPT-5 and GPT-6 families perform consistently in the 55.0%–61.1% macro-F1 band. Notably, Gemma 4 31B in zero-shot ( 61.8 ± 0.2 61.8\pm 0.2 ) is statistically on par with GPT-5 ( 61.1 ± 1.6 61.1\pm 1.6 ; p ≥ 0.05 p\geq 0.05 , see Appendix G.2 ).
blocks.zh: 对人判断的CS-SeLeRoSa-Gold基准模型的评价揭示了一种有趣的相互作用:较弱的模型从合成到黄金基本一致(±2\pm2分;例如,Gemma 3 27B的变化为− 0.9-0.9分,Llama 3.1 8B的变化为− 1.8-1.8分,Roemma 2 9B + 1.8分,RoLlama + 2.2+2.2分),而能力模型则明显下降(Gemma 4 26B 降5.5分,Gemma 4 31B 降6.3分,GPT-6 Luna 降8.9分,GPT-5 降9.9分)。 这表明这些模型对合成代的某些模式有部分反应过度. 在对黄金组合的前沿模型进行评估时,来自GPT-5和GPT-6家族的模型在55.0%–61.1%的宏-F1波段中表现一致. 值得注意的是,Gemma 4 31B的零射(61.8 ± 0.2 61.8\pm 0.2)在统计上与GPT-5(61.1 ± 1.6 61.1\pm 1.6;p 0.05 p\geq 0.05,见附录G.2)相同。

blocks.en: RQ2: Can Chain-of-Thought reasoning or supervised fine-tuning mitigate code-switching degradation?
blocks.zh: RQ2:思维链推理或受监督的微调能缓解代码切换退化吗?.

blocks.en: To mitigate zero-shot performance drops, we evaluate models under chain-of-thought prompting and supervised fine-tuning settings. The effects of CoT are twofold. First, it improves performance for weaker models, yielding gains ranging from 3.1 points on Llama 3.1 8B (44.8 to 47.9) to 11.5 points on RoMistral 7B. CoT also stabilizes generation across seeds, drastically reducing variance (e.g., RoMistral variance drops from ± 14.4 \pm 14.4 to ± 1.0 \pm 1.0 ). Conversely, CoT provides no benefit for top-performing models, yielding a slight decline on Gemma 4 31B ( − 1.6 -1.6 points on CS).
blocks.zh: 为了减少零射的性能下降,我们在思维链的提示和监督下的微调设置下评价模型. COT的影响是双重的. 首先,它提高了较弱模型的性能,从Llama 3.1 8B(44.8至47.9)的3.1分到RoMistral 7B的11.5分不等. CoT还稳定了种子的生成,大大降低了差异(例如,RoMistral差异从±14.4\pm 14.4下降到±1.0\pm 1.0)。 反之,CoT对顶级表现模式没有好处,使得Gemma 4 31B(CS的−1.6-1.6分)略有下降.

blocks.en: RoLlama 3.1 8B represents a negative outlier in the results, where chain-of-thought degraded performance by 6.7 points on CS-SeLeRoSa and 7.9 points on CS-SeLeRoSa-Gold. Appendix G.6 shows that format failures do not represent the failure mode of the chain-of-thought regime, since the number of unparseable outputs overall does not increase proportionally. Instead, most errors come from label flips from factual to satirical, while chain-of-thought reasoning traces amplify the satire prediction bias, treating everyday colloquialisms as satire. This issue is resolved under supervised fine-tuning. Across the board, performance meaningfully improves, providing the highest scores on our benchmark. Specifically, Gemma 4 31B reaches a 77.5% F1 score (with an increase of 9.4 points), while models such as RoMistral 7B and Gemma 3 27B achieve significant gains of 37.8 and 38.4 F1 points, respectively. In fact, fine-tuning models on code-switched data fully recovers performance to match or exceed the monolingual baseline (within − 0.8 -0.8 to + 2.3 +2.3 F1 points for most architectures, and outperforming by + 5.9 +5.9 points from 69.0% to 74.9% for Llama 3.1 8B). High performance gains are also observed on the gold set when compared with the zero-shot and chain-of-thought settings. The highest score is achieved, again, by Gemma 4 31B, outperforming zero-shot proprietary models by a significant margin of 11.5 points.
blocks.zh: RoLlama 3.1 8B代表了结果中的负值,其中CS-SeLeRoSa上的思维链退化性能6.7分,CS-SeLeRoSa-Gold上的7.9分. 附录G.6显示,格式故障并不代表思维链制度的故障模式,因为无法分割的产出总数没有按比例增加。 相反,大多数错误来自从事实到讽刺的标签翻转,而思维的连锁推理则会扩大讽刺的预测偏差,将日常的论调视为讽刺。 这个问题在监督的微调下解决。 全面来说,业绩有了有意义的改善,为我们的基准提供了最高的分数。 具体来说,Gemma 4 31B达到77.5%的F1分(增加9.4分),而RoMistral 7B和Gemma 3 27B等型号分别取得了37.8分和38.4 F1分的重大收益. 事实上,在代码切换数据上的微调模型会完全恢复性能,以匹配或超过单一语言基准(大多数架构在− 0.8-0.8至+2.3+2.3 F1分之间,优于+5.9+5.9分,Llama3.1 8B为69.0%至74.9%). 与零镜头和思维链设置相比,在黄金组合上也观察到高性能增益。 最高得分再次由Gemma 4 31B实现,以11.5分的显著比分超越了零射的专有模式.

blocks.en: RQ3: How do generation methods and target languages influence model failure modes?
blocks.zh: RQ3:生成方法和目标语言如何影响模型失败模式?

blocks.en: As mentioned earlier, a common reason for performance degradation is the high False Positive Rate (FPR), i.e., the models overpredict satire, as detailed in Appendix G.5 . Across settings, when code-switching is incorporated (mostly preserving the input prompts, while adding details regarding the code-switching regime), FPR raises to very high values, e.g., for RoLlama 3.1 8B it goes from 51.2% to 82.5% under random replacement, and for Gemma 3 27B it goes from 76.3% to 97.9% under the same setting. Meanwhile, GPT-5 mini remains robust against language variation and generation methods, with its FPR remaining generally invariant between 26.0% and 29.6% across methods ( p > 0.09 p>0.09 , see Table 22 ). Instead, this model suffers from an increase in False Negative Rate (FNR). In the supervised fine-tuning regime, the FPR collapses to 17.9%–38.0%.
blocks.zh: 如前所述,性能退化的一个常见原因是高假正率(FPR),即如附录G.5所详述的模型过于预测的讽刺。 在整个设置中,当输入交换符(主要是保存输入提示符,同时添加关于密码交换机制的细节)被整合时,FPR提升到非常高的值,例如,对于RoLlama 3.1 8B来说,在随机替换下从51.2%升至82.5%,对于Gemma 3 27B来说,在同一情况下从76.3%升至97.9%。 与此同时,GPT-5小型机车在语言变异和生成方法上依然很强,其FPR在各种方法上一般在26.0%至29.6%之间变化不大(p > 0.09 p > 0.09,见表22 ) 。 相反,该模型的假负率(FNR)有所上升。 在监督的微调制度中,FPR崩溃到17.9%+38.0%.

blocks.en: When investigating the degradation per method (see Table 21 from Appendix G.4 ), random replacement yields the highest degradation deltas against the monolingual baseline, with drops in performance across models between − 2.7 -2.7 and − 18.8 -18.8 ( mean = − 9.0 \mathrm{mean}=-9.0 ), acting as an input perturbation method. This is also corroborated by the t-SNE representation of the sentence embedding space (see Figure 8 from Appendix H ), where the random method produces the most separable representations between the original and code-switched samples. The most resilient method remains the dependency-based insertion, which produces more natural code-switched variants (see human evaluation from Appendix F ). Usually the degradation is under 3 points ( 0.0 0.0 points for Llama 3.1 8B, + 0.2 +0.2 points for GPT-6 Luna, − 0.7 -0.7 for Gemma 4 31B, and − 2.3 -2.3 for RoGemma 2 9B).
blocks.zh: 在对每种方法的降解情况进行调查时(见附录G.4表21),随机替换可产生与单一语言基线相比的最高降解三角洲,不同模型的性能下降在−2.7-2.7至−18.8-18.8之间(平均值=−9.0\mathrm{mean}=-9.0),作为输入扰动方法。 这也得到了t-SNE对句子嵌入空间的表示(见附录H中的图8)的证实,该图中的随机方法在原始样本和代码切换样本之间产生最可分离的表示. 最有复原力的方法仍然是基于依赖性的插入法,它产生更自然的密码切换变体(见附录F中的人类评价). 通常降解在3分以下(Llama 3.1 8B的0.0 0.0分,GPT-6 Luna的0.2+0.2分,Gemma 4 31B的− 0.7-0.7分,RoGemma 2 9B的− 2.3-2.3).

blocks.en: When investigating the target language families in Appendix G.5 and G.3 (see Tables 23 and 19 ), we note that Romance languages (i.e., French and Italian) consistently produce lower FPR than Germanic ones (i.e., English and German) across most evaluated models. This result is consistent with the morphological and syntactic similarity between Romance languages and dissimilarities with Germanic insertions. However, we note that between languages, the code-mixing intensity varies, as indicated in Table 4 from Appendix C .
blocks.zh: 在调查附录G.5和G.3中的目标语言(见表23和表19)时,我们注意到,在大多数评价模式中,罗姆语(即法语和意大利语)的生育率一直低于日耳曼语(即英语和德语)。 这一结果与罗曼斯语与日耳曼语插入法的异构性相近的形态学和合成相似性是一致的. 然而,我们注意到,如附录C表4所示,各语文之间的编码混合强度各不相同。

blocks.en: 6 Discussion
blocks.zh: 讨论

blocks.en: Our results suggest that code-switching introduces significant challenges for satire detection, particularly for older and smaller models. Especially in zero-shot settings, these models struggle to disentangle satirical cues from code-switched input, leading to increasing false positive rates. As detailed in Appendix G.3 and evidenced by embedding representation in Appendix H , lexical substitutions act as perturbations that fine-tuning effectively mitigates, recovering performance to match or exceed the monolingual baseline. Other failure modes include instruction-following errors, which are more prevalent in smaller models (specifically, Llama 3.1 8B and RoMistral 7B). The models either fail to produce the XML format, translate tags, use synonyms like ironic, or output corrupted labels (e.g., “ satură ”, Engl. “ get full ”).
blocks.zh: 我们的结果表明,密码转换给萨蒂尔探测带来了重大挑战,特别是对更古老和较小的模型而言。 特别是在零镜头设置中,这些模型努力从代码切换输入中分离讽刺提示,导致假正率上升. 如附录G.3所详述,并在附录H中嵌入代表物所证明的,词典替代起到扰动作用,使微调有效缓解,恢复性能以匹配或超过单一语言基准. 其他故障模式包括指令跟踪错误,这些错误在较小的模型中更为普遍(具体来说,Llama 3.1 8B和RoMistral 7B). 模型要么无法产生XML格式,翻译标记,使用讽刺般的同义词,要么输出损坏的标签(例如“satură ”, Engl.“获得满载”)。

blocks.en: 7 Conclusions
blocks.zh: 7 结论

blocks.en: We presented CS-SeLeRoSa, the first large-scale code-mixed Romanian satire benchmark, evaluating four generation methods across four target languages. Our analysis shows that code-mixing strategies strongly impact lexical naturalness and syntactic cohesion. Furthermore, our model evaluations reveal that while older open-weights models degrade under code-switching noise, modern open models such as Gemma 4 31B rival frontier systems zero-shot and, when fine-tuned, comfortably outperform them on human-adjudicated code-switched satire.
blocks.zh: 我们提出了CS-SeLeRosa,这是第一个大规模编码混合的罗马尼亚语satire基准,评价四种目标语言的四代方法。 我们的分析表明,编码混合策略对词典自然性和协同性有着强烈的影响. 此外,我们的模型评价显示,虽然旧的开放重量模型在密码开关噪声下退化,但现代开放模型,如Gemma 4 31B竞争的前沿系统零射,在微调后,在人判断的密码开关讽刺片上,其性能舒适地超过它们。

blocks.en: Limitations
blocks.zh: 限制

blocks.en: Our work has several limitations.
blocks.zh: 我们的工作有几个局限性。

blocks.en: Dataset Quality. We only investigate synthetic code-mixing generation without assessing for human evaluation on the entire dataset. Some methods, such as random replacement, produce low-quality outputs. Even though those samples do not reflect real-world scenarios, we believe they can still be used to analyze robustness to noisy inputs. However, we mitigate the dataset evaluation by using various metrics, as indicated in Appendix C , and by conducting a human evaluation on a small subset of the data in Appendix F . We agree that synthetic generation through the random method creates degraded samples that may look unnatural to a native speaker. We mitigated this through the carefully crafted human-validated gold set, whose goal was to reduce this kind of noise and contain samples as close as possible to “in the wild” speech Krishnan et al. (2021) .
blocks.zh: 数据集质量. 我们只调查合成密码混合生成,而不评估整个数据集的人类评价. 一些方法,如随机替换,会产生低质量的输出. 尽管这些样本没有反映现实世界的情景,但我们认为,它们仍然可以用来分析强健性,从而产生噪音。 然而,如附录C所示,我们采用各种衡量标准,并对附录F中的一小部分数据进行人类评价,从而减轻了数据集评价的影响。 我们同意,通过随机方法合成的生成物会产生退化的样本,对讲母语的人来说,这些样本可能看起来不自然。 我们通过精心设计的人类验证金包减轻了这种情况,该套金包的目的是减少这种噪音,并尽可能在“野外”演讲中提供样本(2021年)。

blocks.en: Additionally, the naturalness of the data is an inherent limitation of the task, since there are very few sources for satirical news that could also contain code-switching, and reliably identifying those situations is even more challenging. To mitigate this, we based our approach on linguistic theories such as the Matrix Language Frame model Myers-Scotton (1993) , which guarantees that code-switched segments are grammatically and semantically coherent. We hope that our proposed resources will foster the development of new datasets.
blocks.zh: 此外,数据的自然性是这项任务的固有限制,因为讽刺性新闻的源头很少,也可能包含代码切换,可靠地确定这些情况更具有挑战性。 为了缓解这种情况,我们的方法基于语言理论,例如Matrix语言框架模型Myers-Scotton(1993年),它保证了代码切换的片段在语法上和语法上的一致性. 我们希望,我们拟议的资源将促进开发新的数据集。

blocks.en: Romanian as Matrix Language. We only consider the Romanian language as the base language; however, even if we added more source languages, the number of experiments and costs would increase exponentially. Instead, we focused on four target languages with more resources than Romanian, drawn from two language families. Using Romanian as the embedded language instead of the matrix language is an interesting direction for future work, as well as evaluating other code-switching language settings.
blocks.zh: 作为矩阵语言的罗马尼亚语. 我们只把罗马尼亚语视为基础语言;然而,即使我们增加了更多的源语言,实验数量和成本也会成指数增长. 相反,我们侧重于四种目标语言,其资源多于罗马尼亚语,来自两个语言家庭。 使用罗马尼亚语代替矩阵语言作为嵌入式语言是未来工作的有趣方向,同时也评价了其他代码切换语言设置.

blocks.en: Small LLM Evaluation. Our evaluation is limited to several small LLMs due to the increased number of experiments and costs. We tried to mitigate this by selecting various models pre-trained on general and Romanian-specific corpora.
blocks.zh: 小型LLM评价. 由于实验和成本的增加,我们的评价仅限于几个小型有限责任公司。 我们试图通过选择在普通和罗马尼亚特有的公司上经过预先训练的各种型号来缓解这种情况。

blocks.en: Ethical Considerations
blocks.zh: 道德考虑

blocks.en: Our work used publicly available datasets and models. The SeLeRoSa dataset Smădu et al. (2025) is released under the CC BY-NC-SA 4.0 license, with the claim that the original copyright remains with the original authors of the news articles, under the existing copyright laws. The models are either publicly available on HuggingFace or proprietary, but provided using public APIs. Our usage of these resources complies with their intended use. Upon acceptance, we will release our generated code-mixed dataset and code for academic purposes only, under the same license.
blocks.zh: 我们的工作使用公开的数据集和模型。 SeLeRoSa dataset Smădu et al. (2025) 依据CC BY-NC-SA 4.0许可发布,声称根据现行版权法,新闻文章原作者仍保留原版权. 这些模型要么在HuggingFace上公开提供,要么是专有,但使用公共API提供. 我们对这些资源的使用符合其预期用途。 接收后,我们将发布我们生成的密码混合数据集和代码,仅供学术用途,使用同一许可证.

blocks.en: Our dataset retains the original anonymization of the SeLeRoSa dataset, which replaces named entities with generic tags. First, original news sources may reflect specific biases or target particular entities (e.g., public figures, organisations) that should not be reflected in downstream applications. This is especially relevant in satire, which often ridicules those entities ( Burfoot and Baldwin, 2009 ) . By preserving data anonymization, models are encouraged to predict satire from linguistic features and the context rather than reflecting memorised entity-level stereotypes. Moreover, from an ethical standpoint, models must not discriminate against or harm targeted groups. For transparency, the dataset retains the original source URLs to the news, allowing future work studying model biases to retrieve the original entity contexts if needed.
blocks.zh: 我们的数据集保留了SeLeRoSa数据集的原始匿名,该数据集用通用标记取代了命名的实体. 首先,原始新闻来源可能反映具体的偏见或针对特定实体(例如公共人物、组织),这些不应反映在下游应用中。 这在讽刺语中尤其重要,因为讽刺语经常嘲笑这些实体(Burfoot和Baldwin,2009年)。 通过保留数据匿名,鼓励模型从语言特征和上下文来预测讽刺,而不是反映记忆中的实体一级的定型观念。 此外,从道德角度来看,模式不得歧视或伤害目标群体。 为了透明,数据集保留了新闻的原始源URL,允许未来研究模型偏差的工作在必要时检索原始实体背景.

blocks.en: Appendix A Motivation
blocks.zh: 附 录 A

blocks.en: The motivation and ultimate goal of our work, including the dataset construction and extensive evaluation, is multifold:
blocks.zh: 我们工作的动机和最终目标,包括数据集构建和广泛评价,是多方面的:

blocks.en: First , it evaluates the current state of models’ understanding of satire at a granular level. Satire often occurs sporadically rather than persistently throughout an entire text. Sentence-level labels capture this nuance, which is crucial for analyzing long-form texts or instances of sporadic satire.
blocks.zh: 首先,它评价模型在颗粒层对satire的理解的现状。 整个案文中经常零星地出现而不是持续地出现。 句子级标签可以捕捉这种细微差别,这对于分析长式文本或零星讽刺的例子至关重要。

blocks.en: Second , code-switching is a phenomenon accentuated by globalization. As presented in § 1 , Romania has one of the largest diasporas in the European Union, particularly in the countries we investigate for code-switching. Given the growing influence of LLMs through chat-based applications in daily life, which is likely to increase further, we believe evaluating the models’ performance under such conditions is sound. Mixing languages (as suggested by Grattafiori et al. (2024) ) could affect performance, and our results indicate this (see Table 19 vs Table 15 ; in zero-shot and chain-of-thought settings, baseline performance is consistently superior to code-mixed performance).
blocks.zh: 第二,密码转换是全球化加剧的一种现象。 正如第1节所述,罗马尼亚是欧洲联盟中最大的侨民之一,特别是在我们调查密码交换的国家。 鉴于LLMS通过聊天式应用在日常生活中的影响越来越大,这可能会进一步增加,我们认为,评估这些模型在这种条件下的表现是明智的。 混合语言(如Grattafiori等人(2024年)建议)可能影响性能,我们的结果表明了这一点(见表19对表15;在零镜头和思维链设置中,基线性能始终优于编码混合性能).

blocks.en: Third , in Romania, German communities lived in enclaves (particularly in Transylvania), although the number of speakers has declined considerably over the last century. The French influence, however, was significant at the beginning of the 19th century, as many words entered the language from French. Although this is not considered code-mixing, since some words lacked Romanian equivalents, it suggests that historical multilingualism was common, creating an environment in which foreign terms could be readily adopted Boia (2001) . Studies on Romanian-English bilingual speech Bancu (2013) ; Greavu (2022) indicate that the structural integrity of Romanian grammar is strictly maintained as the matrix language, thereby forcing embedded foreign elements to adapt to its complex inflectional and syntactic rules.
blocks.zh: 第三,在罗马尼亚,德意志社区生活在飞地(特别是在特兰西瓦尼亚),尽管在上个世纪里讲阿拉伯语的人数已大幅下降。 然而,法国的影响在19世纪初相当显著,因为许多文字是从法语进入语言的. 虽然这不被认为是代码混合,因为有些词缺乏罗马尼亚语的等效词,但这表明历史多语制是常见的,创造了一种可以轻易采用外语的布亚语(2001年)的环境. 关于罗马尼亚-英语双语语言Bancu (2013);Greavu (2022)的研究显示,罗马尼亚语语法的结构完整性被严格维持为矩阵语言,从而迫使嵌入的外国元素适应其复杂的功能规则和综合规则.

blocks.en: Fourth , for satire itself, as described above, there are very few public sources (satirical expressions usually occur in informal settings Pant and Dadu (2020) ), making it even more challenging to find code-switching in this setting. Therefore, naturally, we developed a code-switched dataset to address this shortcoming until more reliable resources could be generated. Note that this is less of an issue with other languages, such as Hindi.
blocks.zh: 第四,对于讽刺本身,如上所述,公共来源很少(典型的表达方式通常发生在非正式场合Pant和Dadu(2020年)),这使得在这个场合找到代码切换更具有挑战性. 因此,我们自然开发了一个编码交换数据集,以弥补这一缺陷,直至产生更可靠的资源。 请注意,这与印地语等其他语言的问题较少。

blocks.en: Appendix B Translation Evaluation
blocks.zh: 附录B 评价

blocks.en:
To ensure the quality of machine translations in our code-switching pipelines, we evaluate the translation capabilities of large language models using a parallel benchmark. This step is important as most machine-translation evaluations are English-centric, and lack pairs such as Ro → \to X (where X is French, German, Italian).
Specifically, we evaluate two sizes of the Gemma 3 model (27B and 12B) Kamath et al. (2025) and OpenAI’s GPT-5 mini Singh et al. (2026) , a state-of-the-art proprietary model. We select the 27B model as our primary option, with the 12B model as a fallback if it performs reasonably well with faster inference. Both models were trained on over 140 languages.
To select the best translation backbone for our code-switching pipeline, we evaluate candidate models on the parallel FLORES+ benchmark 4 4 4 https://huggingface.co/datasets/openlanguagedata/flores_plus NLLB Team et al. (2024) to assess the models’ performance. It contains high-quality translations for over 200 languages.
We use Romanian as the source language and select two Germanic languages (i.e., English and German) and two Romance languages (i.e., French and Italian) as target languages. The temperature was set to 0.2 for Gemma 3 models to increase determinism, and left at the default for GPT-5 mini. In addition, we set the reasoning effort to low for OpenAI’s model as a reasonable trade-off between performance and cost.
blocks.zh:
为了确保我们编码交换管道的机器翻译质量,我们使用一个平行的基准来评价大语言模型的翻译能力。 这一步骤很重要,因为大多数的机器翻译评价都以英语为中心,缺少罗 →\\to X(其中X是法语,德语,意大利语)等对子.
具体来说,我们评价了Gemma 3模型的两种尺寸(27B和12B). Kamath等人(2025年)和OpenAI的GPT-5迷你辛格等人(2026年),是一款最先进的专有型号. 我们选择27B模型作为我们的主要选择,如果12B模型以更快的推论进行得比较好,它就是一种倒置. 两个模型都接受了140多种语言的培训。
为选择我们编码交换管道的最佳翻译主干线,我们在平行的FLORES+基准4 4 4 https://huggingface.co/datasets/openlanticdata/flores_plus上评价候选模型 无 Team等人(2024年)评估模型的性能。 它包含200多种语言的高质量翻译。
我们使用罗马尼亚语作为源语言,并选择两种日耳曼语(即英语和德语)和两种罗马语(即法语和意大利语)作为目标语言. 温度被设定为Gemma 3模型的0.2,以提高定型性,并在默认时离开GPT-5迷你. 此外,我们把OpenAI模式的推理努力定得很低,作为业绩与成本之间的合理权衡。

blocks.en: Appendix C Code-Mixing Evaluation
blocks.zh: 附录C 编码混合评价

blocks.en:
Automatic Evaluation. Due to the large size of the synthetic dataset, it is challenging to assess its quality manually. Therefore, we employ several automated metrics that capture diversity, semantic similarity, and readability Srivastava and Singh (2021) ; Guzmán et al. (2017) . Code-mixing Index (CMI) Das and Gambäck (2014) indicates the degree of code-mixing in a text, considering the number of words from each language. The Multilingual Index (M-Index) Barnett et al. (2000) measures the language distribution from the text, where 1 1 indicates an equal distribution of languages. The Integration Index (I-Index) Guzmán et al. (2017) quantifies the probability of language switching in the text. The Language Entropy (LE) Guzmán et al. (2017) computes the number of bits required to encode the language distribution from the text. Finally, the Switch Point Average (SP-Avg) Jayanthi et al. (2021) measures the probability of the language being switched in the text. To compute these metrics, we use the CodeMixedNLP toolkit 5 5 5 https://github.com/murali1996/CodemixedNLP Jayanthi et al. (2021) .
For token-level language identification, we employ a series of heuristics based on language-specific special characters. If the word cannot be identified in this way, we use the lingua toolkit 6 6 6 https://github.com/pemistahl/lingua-py , which supports the languages evaluated. Table 4 shows that using the random replacement method achieves much more frequent switching between languages, while the other methods are more balanced.
blocks.zh:
自动评价. 由于合成数据集体积庞大,人工评估其质量十分困难. 因此,我们采用了若干自动化的衡量标准,以掌握多样性、语义相似性和可读性。 代码混音索引(CMI)Das和Gambäck(2014)在文本中表示代码混音的程度,考虑到每种语言的单词数量. 多语种指数(M-Index) Barnett等人(2000年)从文字中衡量语言分布,其中1 1 表示语言分布平等. 融合指数(I-Index) Guzmán等人(2017年)将文本中语言切换的概率量化. Language Entropy(LE) Guzmán et al. (2017)计算从文本中编码语言分布所需的位数. 最后,Switch点平均值(SP-Avg)Jayanthi 等人(2021)测量文本中语言切换的概率. 为了计算这些衡量标准,我们使用CodeMixedNLP工具包 5 5 5 https://github.com/murali1996/CodemixedNLP 贾扬蒂等人(2021年).
对于符号级语言识别,我们使用一系列基于语言特异性字符的heuristics. 如果无法以这种方式识别这个词,我们使用语言工具包 6 6 6 https://github.com/pemistahl/lingua-py,支持被评价的语言. 表4显示,使用随机替换方法实现语言间更频繁的切换,而其他方法则更加平衡.

blocks.en:
Manual Evaluation. We select a subset of sentences from the generated dataset for human evaluation. Specifically, we randomly sample 50 non-code-mixed sentences and extract the corresponding generated code-mixed sentences for each of the four methods and four languages, resulting in a total of 715 samples. These samples were then filtered to remove instances of unnatural code-switching or significant grammatical errors, resulting in a final set of 391 high-quality code-mixed sentences. We call this subset CS-SeLeRoSa-Gold, which, due to its data selection strategy, is meant only for model evaluation.
More details on the annotation protocol and human evaluation statistics are provided in Appendix F .
blocks.zh:
人工评估。 我们从生成的数据集中选择了一组句子用于人类评价. 具体来说,我们随机抽取了50个非编码混合句子,并抽取了对应生成的四种方法和四种语言的编码混合句子,结果总共抽取了715个样本. 这些样本随后被过滤,以去除非自然代码切换或重大语法错误的事例,最终形成391个高质量的代码混合句子. 我们称之为CS-SeLeRosa-Gold子集,由于其数据选择策略,它只用于模型评价.

blocks.en: For each sample in our dataset, we record the generation index; this allows researchers to isolate specific generation variants or evaluate deduplicated splits without repeated base sentences. More specifically, in addition to the columns from the SeLeRoSa dataset Smădu et al. (2025) , our code-mixed dataset adds the following fields for each sample: • code_switch_language : the target language for code switching (the source is by default Romanian); • k : the generation index, k ∈ { 0 , 1 , 2 , 3 } k\in\{0,1,2,3\} , where k = 0 k=0 indicates the original sentence; • cs_method : the code-switching generation method ( none , random , dependency , llm , phrase ), where none corresponds to the original sentence.
blocks.zh: 对于我们数据集中的每个样本,我们记录生成指数;这使得研究者可以孤立特定的生成变体,或者在没有重复的基准句的情况下评价被复制的分裂. 更具体地说,除了来自SeLeRoSa数据集Smădu等人(2025年)的列外,我们的编码混合数据集为每个样本添加了以下字段: • 代码_switch_language :代码切换的目标语言(来源是默认的罗马尼亚语); • k:生成指数, k∈ {0, 1, 2, 3} k\in\{0, 1, 2,3\}, 其中k=0 k=0表示原始句子; • cs_method:代码切换生成方法(无,随机,依赖,llm, 短语),其中没有对应原始句子.

blocks.en: In Table 7 , we present the model checkpoints used in our experiments, along with their sizes. All models used Romanian in their pre-training data. In what follows, we summarize the training data and its importance to each model’s performance.

blocks.en: Llama 3.1 Grattafiori et al. (2024) was trained on a mix of publicly available data totaling more than 15T tokens. The model was optimized for several languages, including English, German, French, and Italian; however, the training data included more languages, such as Romanian.
blocks.zh: Llama 3.1 Grattafiori等人(2024年)接受了关于各种公开数据组合的培训,数据总数超过15T个令牌。 该模式被优化为几种语言,包括英语,德语,法语和意大利语;然而,培训数据包括更多语言,如罗马尼亚语.

blocks.en: Gemma 3 models Kamath et al. (2025) were trained on various data, including web documents (from over 140 languages), code, and images, totaling 14T tokens for the 27B parameters model. However, we could not find exact details about the data.
blocks.zh: Gemma 3模型Kamath等人(2025年)接受了各种数据培训,包括网络文件(来自140多种语言),代码,和图像,共为27B参数模型提供了14T的令牌. 然而,我们无法找到有关数据的确切细节。

blocks.en: Gemma 4 models Abd et al. (2026) represent the next generation of Gemma models, which were trained on a large-scale multilingual dataset, following a similar pretraining setup as Gemma 3. The family introduces a more efficient 26B A4B (i.e., with 3.8B activated parameters) mixture-of-experts model alongside the 31B dense variant.
blocks.zh: Gemma 4 型号 Abd等编. (2026年)代表下一代Gemma模型,经过与Gemma 3.类似的预训设置后,这些模型接受了大规模多语言数据集的培训. 该家族在31B稠密变体的同时引入了更有效的26B A4B(即有3.8B激活参数)专家混合模型.

blocks.en: The Romanian language models Masala et al. (2024) were instruction-fine-tuned on 2.7M instructions and conversations translated from various existing datasets. Because all base models used the same instruction-fine-tuning data, the observed performance disparities stem from differences in their pretraining strategies, data, and architectures.
blocks.zh: 罗马尼亚语言模型Masala等人(2024年)根据各种现有数据集翻译的2.7M指令和对话进行了指导-精细调整。 由于所有基础模型都使用了相同的教学精细调试数据,所观察到的性能差异源于其预训战略,数据和架构的差异.

blocks.en: Regarding the closed-source models (GPT-4.1 mini, GPT-5 mini, and GPT-6 Luna), as with previous models, the data is a mix of publicly available and proprietary sources. The exact size and nature of the datasets are unknown to the public. Additionally, on the smaller gold set, due to cost considerations, we also evaluate GPT-5, GPT-6 Astra, GPT-6 Sol, and GPT-6.1 Sol.

blocks.en: F.1 Annotation Protocol

blocks.en:
The annotation campaign was done using Google Forms 9 9 9 forms.google.com .
Each annotator was presented with the original Romanian sentences, the target language segments used for code-switching, and the original satirical label. Inspired by Chim et al. (2025) , the annotators were provided guidelines with instructions and examples to evaluate each synthetic sentence based on the following criteria: • Class Preservation : Does the synthetic CS sentence preserve the original class (satire or regular)? Yes/No/Ambiguous • Linguistic Acceptability : Is the inserted target language segment grammatical and coherent within itself? Acceptable/Minor errors/Unacceptable • Meaning Preservation : Does the synthetic CS sentence preserve the meaning of the original Romanian sentence? Yes/Partially/No • Code-Switching Quality : Is the switch placement and integration plausible? Good/Mixed/Poor • Final Verdict : Should the synthetic sentence be kept or rejected? Keep/Reject

使用Google Forms 9 9 9 forms.

blocks.en: The annotators were instructed to reject any synthetic sentence that introduces hate speech, targeted insults, or violent content not present in the original. The full annotation guidelines are provided in the Supplemental Materials.
blocks.zh: 指示注释者拒绝任何引入仇恨言论、有针对性的侮辱或原文中没有的暴力内容的合成判决。 《补充材料》提供了完整的说明准则。

blocks.en:
The annotation process was performed in two phases. First, the Calibration Phase , where annotators labeled a small set of sentences to align their understanding of the guidelines. Second, the Batch Annotation Phase , where the remaining workload was distributed in manageable batches. To make the process easier to leverage, we provided the data in batches of approx. 40 examples, containing code-mixed sentences whose target languages were known by the annotator. An example is presented in Figure 2 .
At the end, we checked the agreement among annotators, and in case of disagreements, they discussed to reach a consensus. A final human verification was then performed on all samples to ensure response quality and identify any potential issues.
blocks.zh:
注释过程分两个阶段进行。 首先,校准阶段,其中注释者给一组小句子贴上标签,以协调他们对准则的理解。 第二,批批注阶段,其余工作量按可处理批次分配。 为了使这一过程更容易发挥杠杆作用,我们提供了几批近似数据。 40例,包含代码混合句子,其目标语言为注释者所知. 图2提供了一个例子。
最后,我们检查了注释者之间的协议,如果出现分歧,他们讨论达成共识。 然后对所有样本进行了最后的人类核查,以确保反应质量和确定任何潜在问题。

blocks.en: In addition, to the best of our knowledge, we note that this is the first work to include such a rich set of categories labeled by human annotators for code-switched sentences. Most works limit themselves to fewer criteria (e.g., naturalness and acceptability Sterner and Teufel (2025b) ) or employ humans in the loop to validate and fix the samples Olaleye et al. (2025) .
blocks.zh: 此外,据我们所知,我们注意到,这是首次将人类注释家为密码切换句子贴上标签的如此丰富的分类列入工作。 大多数作品将自身限制在较少的标准(如自然性和可接受性Sterner和Teufel(2025b)),或者在循环中雇用人类验证和固定样品. 奥拉利耶等人(2025年).

blocks.en: Since the samples are synthetically generated, we provide this minimal set of categories to label to reduce annotation bias. The questions are designed to identify potential misinterpretations of the guidelines and to fix them in a timely manner. That is, if we found contradictions during annotation (e.g., the annotator considered the linguistic acceptability unacceptable; however, the final verdict was to keep the sample), we addressed them in the adjudication and final verification stages. The number of options per question was kept low (i.e., 2-3 categorical options).
blocks.zh: 由于样品是合成生成的,我们提供了这组最低限度的分类来进行标签,以减少注释偏差. 这些问题旨在查明对准则的潜在误解并及时予以纠正。 也就是说,如果我们在注解中发现矛盾(例如,注解者认为语言上的可接受性是不可接受的;然而,最后的裁决是保留样本),我们在裁决和最后核查阶段处理了这些矛盾。 每个问题选项的数量一直很低(即2-3个绝对选项)。

blocks.en: We also note that throughout the annotation process, the human experts identified additional aspects that could be interesting to investigate. For example, the phonetic/pronunciation aspect affects how easily integrated a code-switched phrase is in the matrix sentence. Additionally, some words may be pronounced similarly despite having different meanings or parts of speech (e.g., “joc” in Romanian can mean the noun “game” or the first-person singular verb “to play”). However, we leave this investigation as future work.
blocks.zh: 我们还注意到,在整个注释过程中,人类专家确定了值得调查的其他方面。 例如,语音/发音方面会影响矩阵句子中一个密码开关的短语如何容易融合. 此外,有些词语尽管有不同的含义或部分言论(例如,罗马尼亚语中的“joc”可以指名词“游戏”或第一人称单词“要玩”),但也可以同样发音。 然而,我们将此调查留作今后的工作。

blocks.en: F.2 Data Selection
blocks.zh: F.2 数据选择

blocks.en:
To obtain a representative subset, we select sentences from the generated dataset for human evaluation. Specifically, we randomly sampled 50 non-code-mixed Romanian sentences across the test set. We extracted the corresponding generated code-mixed sentences for each of the four methods and four languages.
We deduplicated the generated samples and removed those that were not translated before sampling.
In total, we annotated 715 samples. The base sentences contained 37 satirical (i.e., 74%) and 13 regular (i.e., 26%) samples, distributed among social (i.e., 78%) and technology and science (i.e., 22%) domains. For each language, between 150 and 200 samples were manually labeled (see also Table 8 ).
blocks.zh:
为了获得一个具有代表性的子集,我们从生成的数据集中选择句子进行人类评价. 具体地说,我们随机抽取了50个非编码混合的罗马尼亚句子,横跨测试集. 我们为四种方法和四种语言中每种语言提取了相应的生成的编码混合句子.
我们复制了生成的样品,并移除了在取样前没有翻译的样品。
我们总共给715个样本做了注释 基本句子包含37个讽刺(即74%)和13个常规(即26%)样本,分布于社会(即78%)以及技术和科学(即22%)领域。 对于每种语言,150至200个样本都用人工标记(另见表8)。

blocks.en: F.3 Annotation Statistics
blocks.zh: F.3 注释统计

blocks.en: Label Distribution. Following human-led adjudication on the initially selected data, we derived a final high-quality benchmark of 391 samples (54.7% of the total annotated set, see Figure 6 ), as presented in § F.1 . The per-language acceptance distribution is presented in Table 8 . Investigating the acceptance rate at a more granular level in Figure 3 , the LLM-generation and dependency-based approaches achieved the highest rates, over 60% and, in some cases, 80%. Also, as expected, the random replacement method generates low-quality samples (i.e., acceptance rate is under 20%), mainly due to violations of linguistic rules or mistranslations caused by a lack of context. The most common reason for rejection was the poor quality of code-switching, with 63.9% of the samples being annotated as poor code-switching quality (see Figure 4 ). This is followed by a significant margin by linguistic errors (34%) and meaning loss (26.9%). Only 8% of the rejection cases involved a loss of class label, usually due to ambiguity or clarity reasons.
blocks.zh: 标签发行. 在对最初选定的数据进行人为主导的裁决之后,我们得出了391个样本的最终高质量基准(占注释集总数的54.7%,见图6),如§F.1所示。 每种语文的接受分布情况见表8。 图3显示的接受率比较微小,LLM生成和依赖性方法的接受率最高,超过60%,有时达到80%。 另外,如预期,随机置换方法产生质量低的样本(即接受率低于20%),这主要是由于语言规则的违反或缺乏上下文导致的翻译错误. 拒绝的最常见原因是密码切换质量差,63.9%的样本被注解为密码切换质量差(见图4)。 其次是语言错误(34%)和意义损失(26.9%)。 只有8%的驳回案件涉及类标签丢失,通常是由于模糊或明确的原因。

blocks.en: Criterion Importance. To investigate which criteria most strongly influence annotators’ final verdicts, we employ logistic regression modeling. We train a separate model for each language as well as a global one. In each model, the final verdict (keep/reject) is the binary dependent variable, while the four other criteria are independent variables. This allows us to compute regression coefficients that quantify the relative importance of each criterion in determining the final verdict. Formally, we model:

blocks.en: We train the logistic regression for at most 1,000 epochs or until convergence. Table 9 presents the logistic regression coefficients learned across target languages and globally. The regression models achieve over 90% in-sample accuracy in predicting the final verdict from the constituent criteria. Upon investigating the regression coefficients, we confirm that class preservation yields the lowest signal. On the other hand, meaning preservation represents the most important feature, while language acceptability and code-switching quality are, to a lesser degree, similarly important.

blocks.en:
Inter-Annotator Agreement. Table 10 shows the overall inter-annotator agreement across criteria. The agreement between annotators for the final verdict reaches 75.9% raw agreement with a Krippendorff’s alpha of α = 0.518 \alpha=0.518 , indicating moderate agreement. Linguistic acceptability ( α = 0.603 \alpha=0.603 ), meaning preservation ( α = 0.609 \alpha=0.609 ), and code-switching quality ( α = 0.655 \alpha=0.655 ) achieve moderate to substantial agreement. For class preservation , raw agreement is high (85.0%), but α = 0.178 \alpha=0.178 due to the prevalence paradox caused by the extreme skew towards the yes label.

blocks.en: In Table 15 , we present baseline results on the original Romanian-only SeLeRoSa dataset across the evaluated models. The more recent Gemma 4 family models outperform other open-weights models by a considerable margin across all settings. The best results are achieved by the 31B dense model, achieving 70.2% in the zero-shot setting, and over 78% in the fine-tuning setting. Romanian adaptation provides a clear advantage for smaller architectures in the zero-shot regime; for instance, RoLlama 3.1 8B outperforms base Llama 3.1 8B by 15.3 F1 points on the monolingual baseline (61.6% vs 46.3%), a gap that narrows under fine-tuning. This shows that Romanian pretraining improves models’ ability to detect satire in text through zero-shot transfer, despite not being trained on satirical data Masala et al. (2024) . In our setup, chain-of-thought shows mixed results. For models such as Gemma 3 27B, Gemma 4 26B, RoMistral 7B, and RoGemma 2 9B, the performance improvement varies between 1 and 10 percentage points. Fine-tuning brings most models over 70% accuracy and F1-scores, largely outperforming the in-context-learning setup. Without fine-tuning, proprietary models like GPT-5 mini (71.3% F1) and GPT-6 Luna (68.1% F1) outperform older open-weights models, though newer models like Gemma 4 31B remain highly competitive (70.2% F1). Among the closed-source models, GPT-4.1 mini underperforms in the zero-shot setting, being the only proprietary model evaluated without any reasoning trace. Incorporating chain-of-thought, its performance increases to 68% across metrics. For Llama 3.1 8B and RoMistral 7B, we notice higher variance in the zero-shot setting, which, as detailed in Appendix G.7 , is a result of the models failing to follow instructions and generating invalid predictions. Analysis regarding why RoLlama 3.1 8B underperforms when employing chain-of-thought compared with the zero-shot setting is presented in Appendix G.6 . Table 16 presents the results on the 50 original Romanian sentences used to derive the gold set. In this setting, besides Gemma 4 31B, we also note other models such as GPT-6 Luna in the zero-shot setting, and RoGemma 2 9B under chain-of-thought achieving competitive performance. In the fine-tuning regime, Gemma 4 31B remains the top-performing model.
blocks.zh: 在表15中,我们列出了各评价模型中仅罗马尼亚的原始SeLeRoSa数据集的基线结果。 较近期的Gemma 4家庭模式在各种场合以相当的幅度超过了其他开放量级模式。 最好的结果是通过31B稠密模式实现,在零镜头设定中达到70.2%,在微调设定中达到78%以上. 罗马尼亚的改造为零射线制中较小的建筑提供了明显优势;例如,RoLlama 3.1 8B比Llama 3.1 8B在单语基线上15.3 F1分(61.6%对46.3%),这一差距在微调下缩小。 这表明,罗马尼亚的预训提高了模型通过零射线传输探测文本中的satire的能力,尽管没有接受过关于讽刺数据Masala等人(2024年)的培训。 在我们的设定中,思维链显示的结果好坏参半。 对于Gemma 3 27B,Gemma 4 26B,RoMistral 7B,RoGemma 2 9B等型号,性能的提高在1至10个百分点之间. 精细调整后,大多数模型的精度超过70%,F1分数,基本上超过了内容学习设置。 没有微调,GPT-5型迷你型(71.3%)和GPT-6型Luna型(68.1%F1)等专有型车型就超过了较老的开放重量型车型,尽管Gemma 4 31B等较新型车型仍然具有很高的竞争力(70.2%F1). 在闭源模型中,GPT-4.1在零镜头设定中的迷你表现不佳,是唯一被评价的无任何推理痕迹的专有模型. 将思维链结合起来,其业绩在各种衡量标准上提高到68%。 对于Llama 3.1 8B和RoMistral 7B,我们注意到零射线设定的较大差异,如附录G.7所详述,这是模型未能遵循指令和产生无效预测的结果. 附录G.6对RoLlama 3.1 8B为何在采用与零射线设定相比的思想链时表现不佳的分析。 表16列出了用于提取黄金的50个原始罗马尼亚句子的结果。 在此设定中,除了Gemma 4 31B外,我们还注意到其他模式,如零镜头设定中的GPT-6 Luna,以及思维链下实现竞争性能的RoGemma 2 9B. 在微调制度中,Gemma 4 31B仍然是表现最好的模式.

blocks.en: We present the results in Table 17 on the entire test set, and Table 18 on the gold evaluation dataset. In the zero-shot setting, Gemma 4 31B (68.1% F1-score) achieves comparable results with proprietary reasoning models (e.g., GPT-5 mini, 69.5%) or even surpasses them (e.g., GPT-6 Luna, 67.0%). Among Romanian-adapted models, RoGemma 2 9B achieves the strongest results across all regimes (reaching 75.4% under fine-tuning), outperforming other Romanian-adapted architectures like RoLlama and RoMistral.
blocks.zh: 我们在表17中介绍了整个测试组的结果,在表18中介绍了黄金评估数据集的结果。 在零镜头设定中,Gemma 4 31B(68.1%的F1-score)以专有推理模型(如GPT-5迷你,69.5%)或甚至超过它们(如GPT-6 Luna,67.0%)取得可比的结果. 然而,包括思维链推理痕迹,模型表现不佳,两个度量衡都达到了66.5%,而微调模型在两个度量衡中都达到了77%以上. 在罗马尼亚改造的模型中,RoGemma 2 9B在所有政权中都取得了最强的成绩(在微调下达到75.4%),优于其他罗马尼亚改造的建筑如RoLlama和RoMistral.

blocks.en: When evaluating only on the gold set, the discrepancy between open-source and proprietary models remains diminished. Gemma 4 31B remains the best-performing model, achieving around 62–63% in both metrics in zero-shot and chain-of-thought settings, and around 72–73% in the fine-tuning setting. We observe that frontier models do not manage to surpass it, and, in fact, proprietary models tend to plateau just slightly under Gemma 4 31B. Romanian pre-trained models continue to transfer better than their base model counterparts in the zero-shot setting (e.g., RoLlama 52.6% vs base Llama 44.8% on CS-SeLeRoSa, and 54.8% vs 43.0% on CS-SeLeRoSa-Gold).
blocks.zh: 在仅仅对黄金套件进行评价时,开源模型和专有模型之间的差距仍然缩小。 Gemma 4 31B仍然是表现最好的模式,在零镜头和思维链的环境下,两个度量标准都达到了62-63%左右,在微调环境下达到了72-73%左右。 我们观察到前沿模型无法超越它, 事实上,专有模型往往在Gemma 4 31B下稍稍处于平原状态。 罗马尼亚预先训练的模型在零射线设定中继续比其基本模型对等机型转录更好(如:RoLlama 52.6% vs Base Llama 44.8% on CS-SeLeRoSa,54.8% vs 43.0% on CS-SeLeRoSa-Gold).

We also report fine-tuning results for open-source models, which show significant improvements across all languages and generation methods over zero-shot and chain-of-thought prompting.
blocks.zh: 为了更好地量化不同目标语言和代码切换生成方法之间的性能差异,表19列出了全部测试集中所有模型和语言对子的详细分类,表20报告了相应的金本位基准的分类. 我们还报告开放源码模型的微调结果,这些结果表明,所有语言和生成方法比零镜头和思维链促动有重大改进。

blocks.en: We note that the random-replacement strategy naturally yields degraded outputs. However, we applied the method exactly as proposed by Krishnan et al. (2021) , without additional filtering, to maintain consistency with prior work. Broken down by model and method, models generally underperform under this strategy. Nevertheless, the performance drop varies substantially across architectures: for GPT-5 mini, the variance across methods is at most 5%, demonstrating higher robustness to noisy lexical substitutions. In other cases, random insertion acts as an adversarial perturbation, reducing performance by more than 10% compared to syntactically informed methods. Fine-tuning on this data yields results competitive with other code-switching generation methods, indicating that models can adapt effectively even in noisy environments. While not aimed at maximizing naturalness or simulating real-world usage, it serves as a valid, fast data augmentation strategy and provides a useful stress test for assessing model robustness. The dependency-based method is the most resilient, as it preserves syntactic dependencies from the original matrix language. For top-performing models like Gemma 4 31B and GPT-5 mini, zero-shot performance shows no statistically significant degradation compared to the monolingual counterpart.
blocks.zh: 我们注意到,随机替换战略自然产生退化的产出。 然而,我们完全按照Krishnan等人(2021年)的建议运用了这种方法,但没有进行额外的过滤,以保持与先前工作的一致性。 按模型和方法划分,模型在这项战略下一般表现不佳。 然而,各建筑的性能下降差异很大:对于GPT-5小型,不同方法的差异最多为5%,表明对吵闹的词汇替代的强烈度更高。 在其他情况下,随机插入起到对抗性扰动的作用,与战术上知情的方法相比,性能降低了10%以上. 对这些数据的精细调整产生与其他代码切换生成方法竞争的结果,表明模型即使在吵闹的环境中也能有效适应. 虽然它的目的不是尽量扩大自然性或模拟现实世界的使用,但它是一种有效、快速的数据增强战略,为评估模型的稳健性提供了一个有用的压力测试。 基于依赖的方法是最具有弹性的,因为它从原始矩阵语言中保留了协同依赖性. 对于Gemma 4 31B和GPT-5 迷你等顶级性能模型,零镜头性能显示与单语对应器相比没有统计显著退化.

blocks.en: When comparing Romance languages against Germanic ones, we note that higher F1-scores are achieved in French and Italian code-mixing, with less degradation, than in English and German. Across zero-shot settings on open-weights models, German sees the steepest degradation (e.g., down to approx. 35% on RoMistral 7B).
blocks.zh: 在比较罗曼斯语和日耳曼语时,我们注意到,在法语和意大利语的编码混合中实现了更高的F1-分数,其退化程度低于英语和德语. 在开放重量模型上的零镜头设置中,德国人看到最陡峭的降解(例如,在RoMistral 7B上降至约35%).

blocks.en: Chain-of-thought may help improve performance in smaller models; for example, RoMistral 7B sees gains ranging from +8 to +13 points in F1-score. On the proprietary GPT-4.1 mini model, the gains remain more limited between +2 to +7 points in F1-score. In contrast, on RoLlama 3.1 8B, we notice a consistent performance degradation across all methods and languages, of about -5 to -10 percentage points in macro-F1. Under fine-tuning, on the other hand, models tend to recover, reaching over 70% in noisy random code-mixing, reducing the performance gap across models. Gemma 4 31B achieves top performance across nearly all language and method combinations, in the fine-tuning regime.
blocks.zh: 思考链可能有助于在较小的模型中提高性能;例如,RoMistral 7B在F1-分数中看到从+8到+13分的增益. 在专有的GPT-4.1迷你型号上,收益在F1-分数的+2到+7分之间仍然较为有限. 相比之下,在RoLlama 3.1 8B上,我们注意到所有方法和语言的性能持续退化,在宏观F1中约为-5至10个百分点。 另一方面,在微调下,模型倾向于恢复,在吵闹的随机编码混合中达到70%以上,缩小了各模型的性能差距. Gemma 4 31B在微调制度下实现了几乎所有语言和方法组合的顶级性能.

blocks.en: On the CS-SeLeRoSa-Gold set, we see similar trends, with the highest performance being achieved on phrase- and LLM-based generation, where GPT-5 reaches approx. 70% in F1-score, and GPT-5 mini outperforms it by 2%. Likewise, Gemma 4 31B achieves the highest performance while fine-tuned. Despite filtering out unnatural code-mixed sentences after the human annotation step, models still tend to underperform, especially under the random method.
blocks.zh: 在CS-SeLeRosa-Gold集上,我们看到类似的趋势,在基于短语和LLM的生成上取得了最高的性能,其中GPT-5在F1-分数中达到约70%,GPT-5的迷你性能比它高出2%. 同样,Gemma 4 31B在微调时也实现了最高性能. 尽管在人类注释步骤后过滤出非自然的代码混合句子,模型仍然倾向于表现不佳,特别是在随机方法下.
