blocks.en: Degradation varies across models and methods. Analyzing the results broken down by method (see Table 21 , reporting the mean F1 degradation across 3 seeds for open-weights models, and a single run for closed-source models), we observe that for most models, the worst degradation is observed when employing the random code-switching method, reaching up to 18.8% (Gemma 3 27B) and 16.9% (RoLlama 3.1 8B). On the other side of the spectrum, the dependency-based method, which preserves syntactic structure, causes a much smaller degradation, under 5% for almost all models (and near zero for Gemma 4 31B, GPT-5 mini, and GPT-6 Luna). GPT-5 mini remains robust against all code-switching methods, obtaining a maximum degradation of only -4.4% under the random method. Code-switching generation causes statistically significant degradation when compared with the original Romanian sentences for closed-source models ( p < 0.001 p<0.001 under paired McNemar’s test on instance-level predictions) and open-source models ( p < 0.01 p<0.01 under Welch’s t t -test across N = 3 N=3 runs), except for Llama 3.1 8B and RoMistral 7B due to high run-to-run variance caused by instruction-following failures and invalid outputs.
blocks.zh: 各种模型和方法的退化各不相同。 分析按方法分列的结果(见表21,报告开放重量模型的3个种子的平均F1降解率,以及封闭来源模型的单一运行率),我们观察到,对于大多数模型来说,在使用随机密码交换方法时,观察到最严重的降解率高达18.8%(Gemma 3 27B)和16.9%(RoLlama 3.1 8B)。 在光谱的另一侧,基于依赖的方法保留了合成结构,导致更小的降解,几乎所有模型的降解率都低于5%(Gemma 4 31B,GPT-5迷你,和GPT-6 Luna). GPT-5型迷你型仍然强力对抗所有密码开关方法,在随机法下,其最大降解率只有−4.4%. 与罗马尼亚最初对闭源模型的句子(在麦克尼马尔对实例级预测的测试下,p < 0.001 p < 0.001)和开源模型(p < 0.01 p < 0.01在Welch的 t测试下,横跨 N = 3 N = 3 运行)相比,代码切换生成在统计学上造成了显著的退化,但Llama 3.1 8B和RoMistral 7B除外,原因是指令跟踪失败和无效输出导致运行高度差异。

blocks.en: We showcase the failure modes (i.e., False Positive Rate (FPR) and False Negative Rate (FNR)) for every model across methods, languages, and prompting/fine-tuning settings. In the language and method breakdown (Tables 22 and 23 ), for open-weights models, we report the results aggregated using majority voting across 3 runs, whereas for closed-source models, we report single runs.
blocks.zh: 我们展示每个模型在方法、语言和激励/精细调整设置上的失败模式(即假正率和假负率)。 在语言和方法分类(表22和23)中,对于开放加权模式,我们使用3次运行的多数表决报告汇总结果,而对于封闭源代码模式,我们报告单次运行。

blocks.en: This analysis reveals that in zero-shot settings, most models tend to exhibit a very high FPR combined with a very low FNR, as seen in the cases of Gemma 3 27B and RoLlama 3.1 8B. This means that these models rarely miss actual satire (i.e., low FNR), but they constantly misclassify regular news as satire (i.e., high FPR). Investigating these results more closely, we notice a consistent pattern where the models perform best (lowest FPR) on syntactically structured methods such as dependency-based, followed by phrase-based and LLM-based generation methods, and worst on random code-switching. For well-performing localized models (i.e., RoLlama 3.1 8B, RoGemma 2 9B, and Gemma 3 27B) as well as GPT-4.1 mini, the increase in FPR from the monolingual baseline to any code-switching setting is statistically significant (p < 0.05 under Welch’s t-test for open-source models and p < 0.01 under a Chi-squared test for GPT-4.1 mini). GPT-5 mini remains an exception, maintaining a robust and statistically invariant FPR between 26–30% (p > 0.09) regardless of the code-switching method. For Llama 3.1 8B and RoMistral 7B, this observation is not consistent due to high variance in the predictions, which matches their overall low performance and instability on the dataset. Conversely, when looking at the FNR, it drops as the generation method becomes noisier. Since models over-classify these noisy sentences as satirical, they tend to miss very few true satirical sentences.
blocks.zh: 这一分析显示,在零射的环境下,大多数模型往往表现出非常高的FPR与非常低的FNR结合,这在Gemma 3 27B和RoLlama 3.1 8B的案例中都可以看到. 这意味着这些模型很少错过实际的satire(即低FNR),但他们经常将普通新闻误称为satire(即高FPR). 更仔细地调查这些结果,我们注意到一种一致的模式,即模型在基于依赖性等战术结构化方法上表现最佳(最低FPR),其次是基于短语和LLM的生成方法,在随机代码切换上表现最差. 对于性能良好的本地化模型(即RoLlama 3.1 8B、RoGemma 2 9B和Gemma 3 27B)以及GPT-4.1微型模型,FPR从单一语言基线增加到任何代码交换设置在统计学上都具有重大意义(Welch开源模型的T测试中p < 0.05,GPT-4.1微型的Chi-quared测试中p < 0.01)。 GPT-5小型版本仍是一个例外,无论密码交换方法如何,在26-30%(p > 0.09)之间都保持了稳健和统计变化无常的FPR. 对于Llama 3.1 8B和RoMistral 7B来说,由于预测差异很大,这与数据集的整体性能低和不稳定性相匹配,因此这一观测不一致. 相反,在看FNR时,它会随着生成方法变得噪声而下降. 由于模型将这些吵闹的句子归为讽刺性,所以往往很少漏掉真正的讽刺性句子.

blocks.en: The language breakdown in Table 23 demonstrates that, across almost all models (with the exception of RoMistral 7B), mixing Romanian (i.e., a Romance language) with other Romance languages (i.e., French or Italian) consistently obtains a lower FPR compared to Germanic languages (i.e., English or German). This difference is highly statistically significant at the instance level for the Gemma models (p < 0.001 under a Welch’s t-test) and both GPT models (p < 1e-9 under a Chi-squared test), suggesting that cognate sharing and syntactic compatibility mitigate false-positive satire detection.
blocks.zh: 表23中的语言细分显示,在几乎所有的模型(RoMistral 7B除外)中,罗马尼亚语(即罗曼语)与其他罗曼语(即法语或意大利语)混合,与日耳曼语(即英语或德语)相比,始终获得较低的FPR. 在Gemma模型(Welch ' s t测试下p < 0.001)和GPT模型(Chi-quared测试下p < 1e-9)的例子一级,这种差异在统计学上非常显著,这表明共生共享和合成兼容性减轻了假阳性satire检测。

blocks.en: Finally, Table 24 (reporting the mean FPR and FNR across 3 seeds for open-weights models, and a single run for proprietary models) shows that while zero-shot and chain-of-thought prompting strategies are vulnerable to code-switching noise, supervised fine-tuning on the CS-SeLeRoSa dataset successfully mitigates this bias. Fine-tuning drastically reduces the FPR (e.g., Gemma 3 27B drops from 92.0% to 26.1% FPR; RoLlama 3.1 8B drops from 70.5% to 26.1% FPR) but also increases the FNR. As the decision boundary shifts during fine-tuning, the models become more selective and miss some of the harder satire examples.
blocks.zh: 最后,表24(报告开放重量模型的3个种子的平均FPR和FNR,以及专有模型的单一运行)显示,虽然零镜头和思维链激发策略容易受到密码切换噪声的影响,但CS-SeLeRoSa数据集的监督微调成功地减轻了这种偏差。 微调大幅降低了FPR(例如,Gemma 3 27B从92.0%下降到26.1%;RoLlama 3.1 8B从70.5%下降到26.1%),但也增加了FNR. 随着决定边界在微调过程中的转变,模型变得更有选择性,并错过了一些更难的讽刺例子.

blocks.en: In Table 15 , as opposed to the other open-source models, RoLlama 3.1 8B underperforms in the chain-of-thought setting on the monolingual baseline results, when compared to the zero-shot setting. Specifically, in the zero-shot setting, the model achieved 61.0 ± 0.3 61.0_{\scriptstyle\pm 0.3} % accuracy and 61.6 ± 0.8 61.6_{\scriptstyle\pm 0.8} % in F1-score, while in the chain-of-thought setting, the model achieved 51.9 ± 1.5 51.9_{\scriptstyle\pm 1.5} % accuracy and 50.4 ± 2.1 50.4_{\scriptstyle\pm 2.1} % in F1-score. This represents a roughly 10 percentage point decrease across both metrics; hence, we further analyze this negative result. Table 25 presents the prediction distribution across each seed. Since the trends are similar across seeds, we focus our analysis on seed 1. Out of 2,072 samples, in the zero-shot setting the model predicted 1,343 samples as satire (64.8%), 721 samples as factual (34.8%), and 8 samples were unparseable (0.4%). Using chain-of-thought, the model predicted 1,665 samples as positive (80.4%), 389 as negative (18.8%), and 18 were unparseable (0.9%). We notice a considerable increase in the predicted positive rate of about 15.6 percentage points. Furthermore, among samples correctly classified in zero-shot, 330 factual samples switched to satirical and 6 became unparseable (336 new false positives under CoT), while only 45 satirical samples switched to factual and 5 became unparseable (50 new false negatives).

blocks.en: We inspect the input sentences and reasoning traces as a proxy to assess the model’s reasons for predicting satire on samples that switched their label. We use BERTopic Grootendorst (2022) to extract the main topics from the text. First, we generate an embedding representation using the multilingual Sentence-BERT 10 10 10 We employ the paraphrase-multilingual-MiniLM-L12-v2 model. Reimers and Gurevych (2019) model, use UMAP McInnes et al. (2018) dimensionality reduction to 5 components with cosine metric and 8 neighbours, clustering with at least 10 samples, and c-TF-IDF Grootendorst (2022) for filtering filler words. The representative keywords were extracted following maximal marginal relevance with a diversity of 0.3, and KeyBERT Grootendorst (2020) , and we employ OpenAI’s GPT-6 Luna for human-readable representation labels. Table 26 shows the topics identified.
blocks.zh: 我们检查输入句子和推理痕迹作为代词,评估模型在切换标签的样品上预测讽刺的理由。 我们用BERTOPIC GROOTENDORST(2022年)从文本中提取主要话题. 第一,我们使用多语言句式-BERT 10 10 创建嵌入式代表,我们使用多语言句式-MiniLM-L12-v2模式。 Reimers和Gurevych(2019年)模型,使用UMAP McInnes等人(2018年)的维度还原到5个组件,并配有余弦公尺和8个邻位,集中至少10个样本,C-TF-IDF Grootendorst(2022年)用于过滤填充词. blocks.en: Analyzing the reasoning traces, we notice that the model overassumes that certain situations or phrases are associated with satire. For example, in the sentence “Îmi pot imagina mii de aplicaţii pentru această invenţie revoluţionară.” (Engl., “I can imagine lots of applications for this revolutionary invention” ), the model assumes that “a high level of optimism and positivity is associated with satire” , and “even without enough context, [it] considers it satirical” . In another example, “Promp t , i, ca întotdeauna!” (Engl., “Prompt, as always!” ) the model assumes that the tone is too formal for an everyday conversation, and “as always” suggests irony, although the ground truth suggests otherwise.
blocks.zh: 分析推理痕迹,我们注意到模型过度假定某些情况或短语与讽刺有关。 例如,在“pot imagina mii de aplica ii pentru această invenţie revoluţionară”一句中。 (Engl.,“我可以想象这个革命发明的许多应用”),该模型假定“高度乐观和积极性与讽刺有关”,以及“即使没有足够上下文,它也认为是讽刺的”。 在另一个例子中,“Promp t, i, ca întotdeauna!” (英文:“Prompt, as always!”)这个模式假设语气太正式, 不适合日常谈话,

blocks.en: When looking at the input sentences that changed their label, we notice several main topics that were affected, including “Reported Problems and Conditions” , “Romania Satirical Discoveries” , and “Personal Experiences and Problems” . Additionally, a large portion of the affected sentences (39.5%, corresponding to the outlier cluster “People Leaving and Changing Positions” ) describe specific individuals and actions, which may also suggest a bias, as satirical news outlets may frequently caricature public figures. This further emphasizes that the model considered colloquial situations as possibly satirical.
blocks.zh: 在审视改变其标签的输入句时,我们注意到一些受到影响的主要议题,包括“报告的问题和条件”、“罗马尼亚的讽刺发现”和“个人经验和问题”。 此外,大部分受影响句子(39.5%,相当于 " 人民离开和改变立场 " )描述了具体的个人和行动,这可能也表明存在偏见,因为讽刺性的新闻机构可能经常讽刺公众人物。 这进一步强调,该模式认为口语状态可能是讽刺性的。

blocks.en: G.7 Instruction Following Error Rate
blocks.zh: G.7 误差率后的指示

blocks.en: In Tables 27 and 28 , we present the instruction-following error rates where models did not produce the expected output given in the prompt instructions, or used during fine-tuning. The reported values represent the average invalid rate across the 3 seeds for open-weights models, and a single run for proprietary models. The highest error rates are obtained by Llama 3.1 8B and RoMistral 7B in zero-shot (23%–25%) and chain-of-thought (6%–11%) settings, while in the fine-tuning setting, error rates drop to almost 0%. Gemma 3 27B, Gemma 4 31B, and the GPT model family achieve under 0.1% formatting error rates. In most cases, the models produced an invalid label while otherwise adhering to the XML format requirement (e.g., instead of “satiră”, they produced “satire”, “satură”, “ironie”, or “ironic”). In some cases, the models produced different XML tags (e.g., using the Romanian translation for “response”, “răspuns”), failed to generate the XML tags, or refused to solve the task.
blocks.zh: 在表27和表28中,我们列出在模型没有产生即时指示中给出的或微调时使用的预期产出时遵循指示的错误率。 报告的数值代表了开放重量模型的3个种子的平均无效率和专利模型的单一运行率。 最高误差率由Llama 3.1 8B和RoMistral 7B在零拍(23%–25%)和思维链(6%–11%)设置中获得,而在微调设置中,误差率降至近0%. Gemma 3 27B,Gemma 4 31B,GPT模型家族在0.1%格式化误差率下实现. 在大多数情况下,这些型号在遵守XML格式要求(例如,不是“satiră”,而是“satură”、“satură”、“ironie”或“ironic”)的同时,也产生了无效的标签。 在某些情况下,这些模型产生了不同的XML标记(例如,使用罗马尼亚语翻译“Reswer”,“răspuns”),未能生成XML标记,或拒绝解决任务。

blocks.en:
In Figure 8 , we present the t-SNE visualization (perplexity of 500) of the original and code-mixed sentences, generated using each method on the four languages: English (EN), German (DE), French (FR), and Italian (IT). We embed the text using the multilingual BERT-cased model 11 11 11 https://huggingface.co/google-bert/bert-base-multilingual-cased . The number of generated samples (i.e., n_cs ) may differ between methods since not all produced exactly k = 3 k=3 variants.
We observe that random code-mixing yields separable representations compared to other approaches, indicating a semantic shift when words are randomly translated. This is also emphasized by the semantic similarity results in Table 5 , and the annotation process that filtered out a large portion of the random and phrase-generated samples. On the other hand, the other approaches generate code-mixed examples that are closer to the original distribution by considering more context when translating text chunks, thereby better preserving semantics. Across languages, we do not see meaningful differences in the representations, which is expected, given that the goal of the synthetic generation was to preserve the original meaning of the sentence by providing translated variations.

我们注意到,与其他方法相比,随机的编码混合会产生可分离的表示,表示在任意翻译词时的语义变化. 表5中的语义相似性以及过滤出大量随机和短语生成样本的注释过程也强调了这一点。 另一方面,其他方法通过翻译文本块时考虑更多的上下文,生成更接近原始分布的编码混合实例,从而更好地保存语义学. 在各种语言中,我们并不认为在表述上存在有意义的差异,这是预期的,因为合成一代的目标是通过提供翻译的变异来保留句子的原始含义.
